introGate.title: Intro gate (hold until satellite in view)
introGate.description: After STEP INTO TIME, hold the timeline at 0 (camera stays put) while scroll flies the satellite in. Real scrolling begins once the satellite reaches its in-view pose. Turn off to let scroll move everything immediately.

introScrollPx.title: Intro scroll (px) for the fly-in

touchScrollPx.title: Touch scroll (px) for full 0â1 range (mobile)

stemFadeIn.description: Fade-in when the stems first start on the CTA click (mirrors Music fade-in).

stemFadeDur.description: How long an individual stem takes to fade in/out when the scroll crosses between mix bands. Wall-clock, so it stays smooth at any scroll speed.

mixBands.description: Each row = a scroll range and the level (0-1) of each stem within it. ctaSfx.description: One-shot fired on the loading CTA click (experienceStart / REPLAY). Empty = none.

ringPulseSfx.title: Ring pulse SFX
ringPulseSfx.description: One-shot fired each time a ringPulse impulse fires. Empty = none.

diamondEndSfx.title: Diamond-arrived SFX
diamondEndSfx.description: One-shot fired when diamondMover reaches its end progress. Empty = none.

rackAppearSfx.title: Rack-appear SFX
rackAppearSfx.description: One-shot fired when a ScrollAppear transition starts (its Appear SFX event). Empty = none.

computeCoreSfx.title: Compute-core SFX
computeCoreSfx.description: One-shot fired when textDataCenter reveals at its trigger progress. Empty = none.

textRackSfx.title: HudText rack SFX
textRackSfx.description: One-shot fired when a HudText with Appear SFX event "audio:textRack" reveals. Empty = none.

textChipSfx.title: HudText chip SFX
textChipSfx.description: One-shot fired when a HudText with Appear SFX event "audio:textChip" reveals. Empty = none.

quantumSfx.title: Quantum (cubes wave) SFX
quantumSfx.description: One-shot fired when the cubesTransition instance with Appear SFX event "audio:quantum" sweeps in. Empty = none.

quantumScrollPitch.title: Quantum Â· Scroll pitch (Ã)
quantumScrollPitch.description: Max playback-speed multiplier the quantum loop reaches while the user scrolls hard. 1 = disabled (constant speed), 2 = up to double speed.

quantumScrollSensitivity.title: Quantum Â· Scroll sensitivity
quantumScrollSensitivity.description: Scroll speed (progress units/sec) at which the pitch hits its max. Lower = reaches full speed-up with gentler scrolling.

scrambleSfx.title: Scramble-text SFX
scrambleSfx.description: One-shot fired when any scramble text (textSatellite / diamondLabel / sceneText) starts decoding. Empty = none.

intelligentLayerSfx.title: IntelligentLayer SFX
intelligentLayerSfx.description: One-shot fired when intelligenceLayer text fades in. Empty = none.

matrixGridSfx.title: MatrixGrid SFX
matrixGridSfx.description: One-shot fired when the matrixGrid veil bursts in (fade-in). Empty = none.

satelliteAichipSfx.title: Satellite AI-chip SFX (loop)
satelliteAichipSfx.description: Looping sound that plays while the cursor hovers the satellite AI-chip label (satellite-aichip). Empty = none.

satelliteAichipFadeOut.title: Satellite AI-chip SFX fade-out (s)
satelliteAichipFadeOut.description: How long the loop takes to fade out when the cursor leaves the label (longer = softer tail).

quantumSfxFadeOut.title: Quantum SFX fade-out (s)
quantumSfxFadeOut.description: How long the quantum loop takes to fade out when the wave leaves (longer = softer tail).

orbitStart.title: Orbit cursor: progress START (ring grows in)

hintStartDelayMs.description: Wait this long after the hint window is entered before it scrambles in â e.g. 600ms of empty space at the very start (progress 0) before "SCROLL TO BEGIN" appears. Hiding stays immediate; a quick exit during the delay cancels the reveal.

orbitScrambleSpeed.description: Decode/scramble speed of the DRAG TO ROTATE label as it resolves in (same effect as the scroll hint).

minScale.title: Min Scale (X / Y / Z) â final card-shape size
minScale.description: FALLBACK only. Used when Use Card System is off, or CardSystem / the camera / card plane refs below are missing.

mainCamera.title: Main Camera
mainCamera.description: The camera that renders the chip (screen camera, NOT the UICamera). Its FOV + distance to the card plane set the responsive target size.

cardPlane.title: Card Plane
cardPlane.description: The nebula2 plane inside sceneChip that becomes card #0. Its authored world size is measured once to compute the shrink factor.

bloomCamera.title: Bloom Camera (optional)
bloomCamera.description: Camera carrying the official "bloom" post-effect script. Leave empty to auto-find the first camera in the scene that has a bloom script.

bloomFadeIn.title: Bloom Fade In (s)
bloomFadeIn.description: Seconds for bloom to ramp from 0 to its configured intensity when entering SceneCar.

bloomFadeOut.title: Bloom Fade Out (s)
bloomFadeOut.description: Seconds for bloom to ramp back to 0 when leaving SceneCar (the effect is removed from the queue once dark).

mouseLook2Roll.title: Look B Â· max roll (deg)
mouseLook2Roll.description: Banking/tilt of the horizon, driven by horizontal cursor. 0 = off.

parallaxSmoothing.description: Easing of the drift (lower = more lag/float).

ctaZoom.description: Extra background zoom-in while the loading CTA is hovered, as a fraction (0.06 = +6%). 0 = off.

ctaZoomSmoothing.description: Easing of the zoom in/out (lower = slower / more cinematic).

parkRelease.title: Park ease range (progress)
parkRelease.description: Scroll-progress distance after pose 4 over which the satellite eases from following the camera to fully parked, so it slows to a stop instead of snapping. Larger = a longer, gentler slow-down. Keep it within the gap before the next scene (e.g. 0.12 â 0.14 = 0.02).

entryScrollControl.description: Let scrolling pull the satellite from off-screen to in-view so the user never has to wait out the full Entry duration. The fly-in follows whichever is further along â the timer or the scroll â so it still auto-plays if the user does nothing.

entryScrollRange.description: How much scroll progress flies the satellite fully in (off-screen â in view). Smaller = it arrives with less scrolling. Only used when "Scroll can drive the fly-in" is on.

deployEndProgress.title: Deploy: force-complete past (progress)
deployEndProgress.description: Scroll progress after which the deploy clip is guaranteed fully open (it normally finishes on its own well before this). Set it to the end of scene 1.

mobileBreakpoint.title: Mobile Â· Breakpoint (px)
mobileBreakpoint.description: Viewport width at/below which the Mobile pose positions below replace the desktop ones.

p3PosMobile.title: Mobile Â· 3 Â· Focus chip  Position (cam-relative)

p4PosMobile.title: Mobile Â· 4 Â· Focus solar  Position (cam-relative)

textureAsset.title: Image Texture
textureAsset.description: The uploaded image file (e.g., JPG, PNG)

cameraEntity.description: The camera looking at the scene

useAlpha.description: Blend using the image's alpha channel (e.g. a PNG/WebP opacity gradient). Turn off for fully opaque images.

bottomFade.description: Fade the image to transparent over this fraction of its height at the bottom edge, so it dissolves into whatever is behind the plane. 0 = off. Turns on alpha blending automatically.

bottomFadeFlip.description: Which edge counts as the bottom. Toggle if the fade lands on the top instead.

labelText.title: Label Text
labelText.description: Text shown to the right of the mini diamond. Leave empty for no label.

cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the diamond to screen so the label sticks to it.

labelMargin.description: Gap between the mini diamond and the text.

labelScrambleSpeed.description: How fast the text resolves (lower = slower).

hideOnScroll.description: Scale the diamond (and its label) back to 0 across the Hide window, so it disappears before the camera leaves the scene instead of drifting into the next one.

hideEndProgress.description: Progress at which the diamond is fully gone. Keep it â¤ the scene end (0.28) so it clears before the swap.

screenEntity.title: Screen Entity (mesh that shows the captured image)

fadeEndProgress.title: Screen Fade End (progress)
fadeEndProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the whole monitor is fully faded out (e.g. once the camera is far enough behind the car). Past this the screen plane AND the UICamera are switched off, so the render-target stops re-rendering every frame. Fully reversible on scroll-back.

freezeAtProgress.description: Turn ON only for the object that should stop reacting to the mouse at a given scroll point (e.g. the diamond). Leave OFF everywhere else.

freezeProgress.description: Global scroll progress by which the parallax is fully at rest. Only used when "Freeze at scroll progress" is on.

freezeFade.description: How much scroll BEFORE Freeze Progress the parallax takes to ease out to rest (smoothstep). Larger = a longer, gentler release; the object is fully frozen exactly at Freeze Progress. Reversible.

positionParallax.title: Enable position offset
positionParallax.description: ON = the cursor drifts the entity's position (Max position offset). Turn OFF for tilt-only parallax (e.g. the diamond, so it rotates but never slides). Default ON so other entities are unaffected.

color.title: Plane Colour
color.description: Base colour shown while the plane is visible.

endProgress.description: Plane is fully gone at this progress. Widen the range = more scrolling needed.

organic.description: 0 = clean circular front. Higher = more warped / uneven erosion.

edgeSoftness.description: Width of the fading boundary between solid and gone.

centerX.title: Dissolve Centre X
centerX.description: Origin of the dissolve across the plane (0 = left, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right).

centerY.description: Origin of the dissolve up the plane (0 = bottom, 0.5 = centre, 1 = top). Flip if it reads inverted for your plane orientation.

waveScale.title: Wave Scale
waveScale.description: Size of the dot groups. Lower = larger, slower groups.

offThreshold.title: Off Threshold
offThreshold.description: How much of the wave keeps dots fully invisible. Higher = dots stay at 0% opacity longer.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Marker at each grid point. Dot = round (default). Cross = a thin plus, matching the cross used elsewhere (hudText / plexus).

scale.description: Higher = more, smaller shapes. Lower = fewer, larger blobs.

coverage.description: How much of the plane the shapes fill. Lower = sparser.

speed.title: Drift Speed
speed.description: How fast the shapes move/morph. 0 = frozen.

pulse.title: Local Breathing
pulse.description: Shapes expand/contract by region over time while TOTAL on-screen coverage stays ~constant. 0 = drift/morph only.

edgeMargin.title: Edge Safe Margin
edgeMargin.description: Clear space kept at the plane top/bottom edges so shapes are never clipped by the boundary.

fadeOnScroll.title: Fade On Scroll
fadeOnScroll.description: Fade the whole background out (or in) across a global scroll-progress window.

fadeStartProgress.title: Fade Start Progress
fadeStartProgress.description: Scroll progress (0â1) at which the fade begins. Full opacity before this.

fadeEndProgress.description: Scroll progress (0â1) at which the fade completes. Fully faded after this.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity of the cloud curtain.

cloudScale.description: Higher = smaller, busier puffs. Lower = big soft clouds.

coreHeight.description: Half-height of the always-solid central band (0..1 of the half plane). Hides the cut.

fadeHeight.title: Cloud Fade Height
fadeHeight.description: How far the clouds extend (and thin out) beyond the solid band, toward top/bottom.

speed.title: Drift Speed
speed.description: How fast the clouds drift/evolve. 0 = frozen.

tilt.title: Band Tilt (deg)
tilt.description: Tilt the solid band / cloud line diagonally. 0 = horizontal.

edgeMargin.title: Edge Safe Margin
edgeMargin.description: Clear space kept at the plane top/bottom edges so clouds are never clipped by the boundary.

targetEntity.title: Target (defaults to this entity)

scrambleSpeed.description: How fast the text resolves (lower = slower). TextScramble units per 1/60s, time-based.

particleSpeed.title: Particle Speed
particleSpeed.description: Travel speed along the thread. Negative reverses the flow direction.

particleBrightness.title: Particle Brightness
particleBrightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the glints.

startMerge.title: Start Merge
startMerge.description: How much the threads converge at the START end (local -X). 1 = all meet at a single point, 0 = fully spread apart. The middle always billows to the full Bundle Spread.

endMerge.title: End Merge
endMerge.description: How much the threads converge at the END end (local +X). 1 = single point, 0 = fully spread apart.

endFade.title: End Fade
endFade.description: Fraction of the length over which the threads & particles fade in/out at each end, so they dissolve instead of looking cut.

mouseInteraction.title: Mouse Push
mouseInteraction.description: Let the cursor shove the threads (and their glints) aside as it passes near them.

mousePush.title: Push Strength
mousePush.description: How far the cursor displaces the threads (world units).

mouseRadius.title: Push Radius
mouseRadius.description: How close the cursor must be (world units) to affect a thread.

mouseSmoothing.title: Push Smoothing
mouseSmoothing.description: Easing of the cursor follow. Lower = more lag/springiness.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the cursor. Auto-detected if left empty.

invertColorFlow.title: Invert Colour Flow
invertColorFlow.description: Reverse the direction the amber/gold/white variation travels along the thread (flips the flow without changing its speed).

textureAsset.title: Image Texture (optional)
textureAsset.description: Leave empty to reuse the texture already on the plane (set by textureMap).

useAlpha.title: Use Image Transparency
useAlpha.description: Blend using the image's alpha channel (same as textureMap).

depthScale.title: Depth Strength
depthScale.description: How much apparent relief. 0 = flat, higher = deeper (too high smears at grazing angles).

heightContrast.title: Height Contrast
heightContrast.description: Curve on brightnessâheight. >1 exaggerates highs/lows, <1 flattens.

invertDepth.title: Invert Depth
invertDepth.description: Flip which tones are "raised". On = dark areas pop out instead of bright ones.

quality.title: Quality (steps)
quality.description: Ray-march samples. Higher = crisper relief, slightly heavier.

reliefShading.title: Relief Shading
reliefShading.description: Fake light raking across the height for highlights/shadows. 0 = keep the original flat colours.

lightAngle.title: Light Angle (deg)
lightAngle.description: Direction the relief light comes from, in screen degrees.

lensDistortion.title: Fisheye Amount
lensDistortion.description: Barrel/fisheye bulge. + = corners bow out (fisheye), â = pinch in. 0 = none.

chromaticAberration.title: Chromatic Aberration
chromaticAberration.description: RGB colour-fringing, strongest toward the corners.

scanlines.title: Scanlines
scanlines.description: Horizontal line darkening, like a scanned readout.

referenceAspect.title: Lens Reference Aspect
referenceAspect.description: Screen aspect (width/height) the radial effects are calibrated to, so they read consistently on any screen shape. 1 = square; 1.78 = 16:9.

alwaysOn.title: Always On
alwaysOn.description: ON = apply the effect across the ENTIRE scroll timeline. OFF = only across the map scene window below (removed from the queue elsewhere, so it costs nothing there).

startProgress.title: Start (progress)
startProgress.description: Scroll progress where the effect fades in (match mapHud's Reveal At). Ignored when Always On.

endProgress.title: End (progress)
endProgress.description: Scroll progress where the effect fades out (match mapHud's Fade Out After). Ignored when Always On.

fade.title: Fade Length (progress units)
fade.description: Width of the fade in/out at each end of the window, so the scanlines/vignette never pop.

mapEntity.title: Map Entity
mapEntity.description: The entity carrying the satelliteFeed script.

camera.title: Camera (optional)
camera.description: Camera viewing the scene. Auto-detected if empty.

strength.title: Anchor Strength
strength.description: 1 = move exactly with the map. <1 lets the objects lag behind for a parallax feel.

engageStart.title: Engage Start (progress)
engageStart.description: Scroll progress at which the objects START following the map pan (e.g. 0.16 = when the diamond begins moving on the map). 0 = always linked.

engageFade.title: Engage Fade (progress)
engageFade.description: Scroll width AFTER Engage Start over which the link eases in from 0 to full (smoothstep), so the objects never jump to the panned position.

panSmoothing.title: Engage Smoothing
panSmoothing.description: Time-based inertia on the ENGAGE transition only (like MouseParallax's smoothing). The hand-off into/out of map tracking glides instead of kinking; once fully engaged the objects are rigidly locked to the pan again (no trailing). Lower = floatier hand-off, 1 = instant.

triggerProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the text scrambles in.

scrambleSpeed.title: Scramble Speed
scrambleSpeed.description: How fast the text resolves (lower = slower).

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to track the map. Without it, the text stays fixed to the viewport.

trackTarget.title: Track Target (the map)
trackTarget.description: Entity the text sticks to (the map). It follows the map's on-screen movement, so it scrolls away WITH the scene. Defaults to this entity.

titleNudgeY.title: Title Nudge Y (px)
titleNudgeY.description: Move the title up (â) / down (+) from its SVG spot.

bodyNudgeY.title: Body Nudge Y (px)
bodyNudgeY.description: Move the body up (â) / down (+) from its SVG spot.

titleNudgeX.title: Title Nudge X (px)
titleNudgeX.description: Move the title left (â) / right (+) from its SVG spot.

bodyNudgeX.title: Body Nudge X (px)
bodyNudgeX.description: Move the body left (â) / right (+) from its SVG spot.

titleNudgeXMobile.title: Mobile Â· Title Nudge X (px)
titleNudgeXMobile.description: Replaces Title Nudge X at/below the breakpoint (â = left / + = right).

titleNudgeYMobile.title: Mobile Â· Title Nudge Y (px)
titleNudgeYMobile.description: Replaces Title Nudge Y at/below the breakpoint (â = up / + = down).

bodyNudgeXMobile.title: Mobile Â· Body Nudge X (px)
bodyNudgeXMobile.description: Replaces Body Nudge X at/below the breakpoint (â = left / + = right).

bodyNudgeYMobile.title: Mobile Â· Body Nudge Y (px)
bodyNudgeYMobile.description: Replaces Body Nudge Y at/below the breakpoint (â = up / + = down).

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Used to measure the fade distance. Defaults to the first camera in the scene.

fadeColor.title: Horizon Colour
fadeColor.description: Colour the floor fades into at distance. Match your background so the horizon disappears.

fadeStart.title: Fade Start (distance)
fadeStart.description: Distance from the camera where the floor starts fading toward the horizon colour.

fadeEnd.title: Fade End (distance)
fadeEnd.description: Distance where the floor is fully the horizon colour. Keep this NEARER than the plane's far edge.

horizontalOnly.title: Horizontal Distance Only
horizontalOnly.description: Ignore the camera's height when measuring distance, so the fade rings are flat on the ground (recommended for floors).

lift.title: Overlay Lift
lift.description: Tiny offset of the overlay above the floor (toward the camera) to avoid z-fighting. Raise it if you see the floor flicker; lower it if the overlay looks detached.

focusTarget.title: Focus Target (object kept sharp â auto-focus)

focusTargetB.title: Focus Target B (focus moves here, e.g. the Chip)

focusSwitchProgress.title: Focus Switch (AâB) â set to subject B start (chip appearStart)

focusSwitchBlend.title: Focus Switch ease band (0 = instant snap)

maxOffset.title: Parallax Max Position Offset (x, y, z)

maxTilt.title: Parallax Max Tilt Degrees (pitch X, yaw Y, roll Z)

followCamera.title: Follow Camera
followCamera.description: Snap the corridor to the camera every frame so it always wraps the view and you fly down its centre. Turn off to place the corridor manually in the world (local -Z = forward).

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera to follow / face. Auto-detected if left empty.

corridorWidth.title: Corridor Width
corridorWidth.description: Leftâright gap of the tube (world units). The left & right walls sit at Â±half of this.

corridorHeight.title: Corridor Height
corridorHeight.description: Topâbottom gap of the tube (world units). The top & bottom walls sit at Â±half of this.

sideLines.title: Side Lines (L / R walls)
sideLines.description: Number of glint-lines across each LEFT & RIGHT wall. Higher = tighter spacing. This is the "dense" pair.

topLines.title: Top/Bottom Lines
topLines.description: Number of glint-lines across each TOP & BOTTOM wall. Keep it lower than Side Lines for wider spacing.

particlesPerLine.title: Glints / Line
particlesPerLine.description: How many glints are strung along each line (its depth resolution). The biggest performance lever after the line counts.

startDistance.title: Start Distance
startDistance.description: How far AHEAD of the camera the corridor begins (world units). Nothing exists closer than this, so the centre stays clear and glints never hit your face.

depth.title: Corridor Depth
depth.description: Length of the corridor beyond Start Distance (world units). Keep it short for the "we just stepped in" feel.

speed.title: Flow Speed
speed.description: How fast the glints stream toward the camera. Negative flows away from you.

fadeFar.title: Far Fade-In
fadeFar.description: Fraction of the depth over which glints fade IN at the far end (appear progressively).

fadeNear.title: Near Fade-Out
fadeNear.description: Fraction of the depth over which glints fade OUT just before reaching the camera.

jitter.title: Line Jitter
jitter.description: Random sideways scatter of each line off its perfect grid slot. 0 = crisp walls, higher = a looser, more organic field.

particleSize.title: Glint Size
particleSize.description: Diameter of each glint (world units). Lower this first to cut overdraw on mobile.

particleBrightness.title: Glint Brightness
particleBrightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the glints.

alwaysOnTop.title: Always On Top
alwaysOnTop.description: Composite the corridor ABOVE every other scene element, regardless of 3D depth â so a scene background (sceneDatacenter, sceneUIâ¦) can never hide it. It does this by drawing into a dedicated overlay layer rendered last, with depth-testing off. Turn OFF to let scene geometry occlude the corridor normally (draws in the World layer).

shrinkFade.title: Fade Out
shrinkFade.description: Fade the glints out as the card finishes shrinking, so the corridor dissolves instead of lingering small. Timed by its own band below (independent of the shrink), so you can make it happen LATE â once the card has already become small.

shrinkStart.title: Shrink Start (progress)
shrinkStart.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor begins reducing. Match sceneChip's Shrink Start.

shrinkEnd.title: Shrink End (progress)
shrinkEnd.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor is fully reduced. Match sceneChip's Shrink End.

minScale.title: Min Scale (X / Y / Z) â match sceneChip
minScale.description: Apparent size the corridor reduces to, per axis. Set these to the SAME values as sceneChip's Min Scale so the corridor and the card shrink identically. X scales the corridor width & glints horizontally, Y the height & glints vertically, Z the corridor depth (tunnel length).

fadeOutStart.title: Fade Out Start (progress)
fadeOutStart.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor STARTS fading out. Set this near/after Shrink End so the fade happens once the card is already small.

fadeOutEnd.title: Fade Out End (progress)
fadeOutEnd.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor is fully invisible.

mouseInteraction.title: Mouse Push
mouseInteraction.description: Let the cursor shove glints aside as it passes near them.

mousePush.title: Push Strength
mousePush.description: How far the cursor displaces the glints (world units).

mouseRadius.title: Push Radius
mouseRadius.description: How close the cursor must pass (world units) to affect a glint.

mouseSmoothing.title: Cursor Smoothing
mouseSmoothing.description: Easing of the raw cursor before it is sampled into the wake. Lower = more lag / springiness.

gapAmount.title: Gap Amount
gapAmount.description: How much of each line is broken up. 0 = solid lines, 1 = mostly gaps.

gapStrength.title: Gap Strength
gapStrength.description: How strongly the gaps cut the glints. 0 = no effect, 1 = glints fully disappear inside a gap.

mousePushRange.title: Push Depth Range
mousePushRange.description: How deep into the corridor (from the near end, world units) the cursor push reaches. Glints deeper than this are left alone, so the back of the corridor stays still.

waveStart.title: Wave Start (progress)
waveStart.description: Global scroll progress at which the lines are still FLAT (wave intensity 0). This is where the user arrives in the scene.

waveEnd.title: Wave End (progress)
waveEnd.description: Global scroll progress at which the wave reaches FULL intensity (Amplitude). Between Start and End the waves grow as the user scrolls.

waveAmplitude.title: Wave Amplitude (height)
waveAmplitude.description: Peak wave height at full intensity (world units) â how far the tallest crests rise above the troughs. This is the FINAL height reached at Wave End.

waveCount.title: Wave Count (sea density)
waveCount.description: How many waves fill the surface (spatial frequency, across BOTH axes). Higher = a busier sea of smaller waves; lower = fewer, broader swells. Need not be a whole number.

waveSpeed.title: Wave Travel Speed
waveSpeed.description: How fast the sea churns (animation). The layers travel in different directions, so this sets the overall pace. 0 = frozen sea, negative = reverses the drift.

order: Radial â sea surface on each wall

waveMode.title: Wave Style
waveMode.description: Which way the wave height displaces the dots. Radial = height pops out of each wall surface (true lake/sea on every wall). Vertical/Horizontal = the height pushes the whole field along one axis. Swirl = both axes (diagonal chop).

fadeIn.title: Fade In
fadeIn.description: Fade the glints IN as the user scrolls into the scene (brightness 0 â full across the band below).

fadeInStart.title: Fade In Start (progress)
fadeInStart.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor STARTS fading in (invisible before this).

fadeInEnd.title: Fade In End (progress)
fadeInEnd.description: Global scroll progress at which the corridor is fully visible.

trailTime.title: Wake Duration (s)
trailTime.description: How long the cursor's wake lingers after it has moved on. Longer = the glints keep drifting after the cursor leaves. Short (0.2) = snappy, long (2.0) = smoky.

trailSpacing.title: Wake Sample Spacing
trailSpacing.description: Minimum cursor travel (world units, at the corridor's push depth) before a new wake sample is recorded. Larger = a coarser, longer wake. 0 = record every frame.

trailFadeIn.title: Wake Fade-In (s)
trailFadeIn.description: Each wake sample ramps up to full strength over this many seconds instead of appearing at once. Cures the visible position "pop" when the cursor moves slowly (samples land sparsely); too high makes the wake feel laggy behind the cursor.

pushAlong.title: Push: Along stroke
pushAlong.description: Shoves glints in the DIRECTION THE CURSOR IS TRAVELLING. This is the ingredient that kills the "circular blast" look â keep it dominant.

pushSwirl.title: Push: Swirl
pushSwirl.description: Adds a sideways curl perpendicular to the stroke, so the wake rolls instead of shoving flatly. Small amounts read as turbulence.

pushOut.title: Push: Outward
pushOut.description: The OLD radial away-from-cursor push, kept only as a garnish so glints don't pile up on the cursor line. Turning this up re-creates the symmetric bubble â keep it low.

emitRate.title: Emit Rate (bolts/sec)
emitRate.description: How many bolts the cursor fires per second while the mouse is over the canvas.

maxBolts.title: Max Bolts
maxBolts.description: Pool size / hard cap on simultaneously live bolts (each is ~one draw call).

travelTime.title: Travel Time (s)
travelTime.description: How long a bolt takes to reach the centre.

fadeTime.title: Fade Time (s)
fadeTime.description: How long a bolt fades out after it arrives.

originDistance.title: Origin Distance
originDistance.description: How far in front of the camera the bolt is born (world units), under the cursor.

targetDistance.title: Target Distance
targetDistance.description: How deep down the corridor (along camera-forward) the centre point sits. Bolts converge here.

targetSpread.title: Target Spread
targetSpread.description: Random scatter of the target around the centre (world units), so bolts fan out a little instead of all hitting one dot.

segments.title: Smoothness
segments.description: Mesh resolution along each bolt. Higher = smoother wobble.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to place/aim bolts. Auto-detected if empty.

waveComplexity.title: Ondulation Complexity
waveComplexity.description: Number of waves along the bolt.

lineWidth.title: Thread Width
lineWidth.description: Thickness of each glowing bolt (world units).

colorSpeed.title: Colour Flow Speed
colorSpeed.description: How fast the amber/gold/white variation travels along the bolt.

brightness.title: Thread Brightness
brightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the bolts.

tailLength.title: Tail Length
tailLength.description: Length of the lit bolt as a fraction of the path. The bolt is a comet that travels to the centre; its trailing end fades out, so the start does NOT stay anchored at the cursor. Smaller = shorter, snappier laser.

fadeOutStart.title: Fade Out Start (progress)
fadeOutStart.description: Global scroll progress at which the effect STARTS fading out (and stops shooting).

fadeOutEnd.title: Fade Out End (progress)
fadeOutEnd.description: Global scroll progress at which the effect is fully gone.

animateO.description: Loop: the O line hides from the top around the circle, then redraws from the top the same way, then holds fully visible for the pause, and repeats.

oHideSeconds.description: How long the line takes to disappear around the circle.

oRevealSeconds.title: O â redraw time (s)
oRevealSeconds.description: How long the line takes to reappear around the circle.

oPauseSeconds.title: O â pause (s)
oPauseSeconds.description: Seconds the logo stays fully visible between loops.

oClockwise.title: O â clockwise
oClockwise.description: Direction the hide/redraw travels around the circle from the top.

oStartAngle.title: O â start angle (deg)
oStartAngle.description: Where the loop begins/ends on the circle. â90 = top (the natural cut at the top of the O).

logoDarkProgress.title: Logo â dark at (progress)
logoDarkProgress.description: Scroll progress where the logo crosses from white to the dark colour (so it stays visible on the white-background scenes). It holds the dark colour through to the end.

fadeOut.description: How long the opacity fade-OUT takes past Fade Out After, in scroll-progress units. 0 = snap off.

showIcon.description: Draw a thin plus/cross to the left of the body, its left edge aligned with the title.

iconSvg.description: Use stroke/fill="currentColor" so Icon Colour tints it.

roughness.description: Surface roughness. 0 = clear glass, higher = frostier. This is the blur, and it is mip-prefiltered so it never produces the old refraction noise.

refraction.title: Refraction Amount
refraction.description: How strongly the glass transmits/refracts the scene behind it.
