thickness.title: Thickness
thickness.description: Medium thickness (scales the refraction offset). 0 = thin pane.

dispersion.title: Dispersion (chromatic)
dispersion.description: Splits colours through the volume (rainbow edges). 0 = off.

attenuation.title: Tint (Absorption Colour)
attenuation.description: Colour the glass absorbs over distance. White = clear. Only applies when Tint Distance > 0.

attenuationDistance.title: Tint Distance
attenuationDistance.description: Distance over which the tint absorbs (needs Thickness). 0 = no tint.

diffuse.title: Base Colour
diffuse.description: Underlying diffuse colour. Keep dark for clear glass.

envReflections.title: Environment Reflections
envReflections.description: Reflect the skybox on the surface (the metallic/glossy sheen).

surfaceOpacity.title: Surface Opacity
surfaceOpacity.description: Below 1 the front faces become see-through so you also see the model's OWN back faces / internal facets through them (the "true glass" layered look). 1 = front faces hide the back faces.

useRefraction.title: Dynamic Refraction
useRefraction.description: ON = the scene visibly bends/blurs through the glass â costs a full-screen scene copy + mip chain EVERY frame (the dominant GPU cost of this effect). OFF = plain alpha transparency: the scene shows through undistorted via normal blending, no grab pass at all. Untick when you only need see-through glass.

startProgress.title: Reveal Start (progress)
startProgress.description: Global scroll progress at which the strings begin drawing on (nothing before this).

endProgress.title: Reveal End (progress)
endProgress.description: Global scroll progress at which the strings are fully drawn (and then stay).

invert.title: Invert Reveal
invert.description: Reverse the draw-on direction along the thread (e.g. bottom â top instead of top â bottom).

revealSoftness.title: Reveal Edge Softness
revealSoftness.description: How soft the moving reveal head is, as a fraction of the thread length. Lower = crisper leading edge.

stringCount.title: String Count
stringCount.description: How many light threads in this bundle.

length.title: Length
length.description: Span of the threads along the entity's local X axis (world units).

bundleRadius.title: Bundle Spread
bundleRadius.description: How far the threads billow apart at the middle. 0 = single tight strand.

startMerge.title: Start Merge
startMerge.description: How much the threads converge at the START end (local -X). 1 = all meet at a single point, 0 = fully spread apart. The middle always billows to the full Bundle Spread.

endMerge.title: End Merge
endMerge.description: How much the threads converge at the END end (local +X). 1 = single point, 0 = fully spread apart.

endFade.title: End Fade
endFade.description: Fraction of the length over which the threads & particles fade in/out at each end, so they dissolve instead of looking cut.

segments.title: Smoothness
segments.description: Mesh resolution along each thread. Higher = smoother curves, slightly heavier.

waveIntensity.title: Ondulation Intensity
waveIntensity.description: Amplitude of the elegant wave (world units).

waveSpeed.title: Ondulation Speed
waveSpeed.description: How fast the threads flow. 0 = frozen.

waveComplexity.title: Ondulation Complexity
waveComplexity.description: Number of waves along the thread. Higher = more sinuous.

lineWidth.title: Thread Width
lineWidth.description: Thickness of each glowing thread (world units).

colorSpeed.title: Colour Flow Speed
colorSpeed.description: How fast the amber/gold/white variation travels along the thread.

brightness.title: Thread Brightness
brightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the threads.

particleCount.title: Particles / Thread
particleCount.description: Glints flowing along each thread. 0 = none.

particleSpeed.title: Particle Speed
particleSpeed.description: Travel speed along the thread. Negative reverses the flow direction.

particleBrightness.title: Particle Brightness
particleBrightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the glints.

revealStagger.title: Reveal Stagger
revealStagger.description: How unevenly the strings draw on. 0 = all reach the end together (flat front). Higher = strings lag behind each other so the front looks ragged/extending, not a flat mask.

fadeStartProgress.title: Retract Start (progress)
fadeStartProgress.description: Global scroll progress at which the strings START retracting. A tail eats in from the START end so the strings are pulled toward the END (the diamond) â the end stays last. Fully drawn before this; set it after the reveal has finished.

fadeEndProgress.title: Retract End (progress)
fadeEndProgress.description: Global scroll progress at which the strings are fully retracted (gone). Set it â¤ the scene end (0.28) so it finishes before the scene swaps. Set both retract values to 1 to never retract.

invertColorFlow.title: Invert Colour Flow
invertColorFlow.description: Reverse the direction the amber/gold/white variation travels along the thread (flips the flow without changing its speed).

height.title: Rise Height
height.description: How far the motes travel up (local Y) before they have fully faded.

bottomSize.title: Bottom Area (X, Z)
bottomSize.description: Footprint where the motes are born (world units, before entity scale).

topSize.title: Top Area (X, Z)
topSize.description: Footprint the motes fan out to at the top. Larger than bottom = spreads upward; smaller = converges.

bottomBias.title: Bottom Density
bottomBias.description: Higher = motes cluster (and linger) lower, so it looks denser near the ground. 1 = even top-to-bottom.

speed.title: Rise Speed
speed.description: How fast the motes travel up (life cycles per second). 0 = frozen.

wander.title: Path Wander
wander.description: Amplitude of the random sideways drift as a mote rises (world units).

wanderFreq.title: Wander Frequency
wanderFreq.description: How many sideways swings a mote makes over its rise. Higher = twitchier path.

fadeIn.title: Fade In
fadeIn.description: Fraction of the rise over which a mote fades in at the bottom.

fadeStart.title: Fade Out Start
fadeStart.description: Fraction of the rise where motes start fading out (fully gone at the top).

sizeTopScale.title: Size At Top (Ã)
sizeTopScale.description: Mote size multiplier by the time it reaches the top (shrink/grow as it rises).

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Overall emissive strength of the motes.

twinkle.title: Twinkle
twinkle.description: How much each mote flickers in brightness over time.

progressFade.title: Visible: edge fade (progress)
progressFade.description: Eases the whole effect in/out at the START and END edges so it never pops. 0 = hard cut.

mouseInteraction.title: Mouse Push
mouseInteraction.description: Let the cursor shove the dust motes as it passes near them. Off = the dust ignores the mouse entirely.

mousePush.title: Push Strength
mousePush.description: How far the cursor displaces the motes (world units, before entity scale).

mouseRadius.title: Push Radius
mouseRadius.description: How close the cursor must pass (world units) to affect a mote.

mouseSmoothing.title: Cursor Smoothing
mouseSmoothing.description: Easing of the raw cursor before it is sampled into the wake. Lower = more lag/springiness.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the cursor. Auto-detected if left empty.

chromatic.title: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic.description: Radially splits each mote's red/blue edges for a lens-fringe / prism look. 0 = off (crisp). Fraction of the mote radius the channels separate by â keep small (0.05â0.2).

trailTime.title: Wake Duration (s)
trailTime.description: How long the cursor's wake lingers after it has moved on. THIS is the "settling" feel â longer = the dust keeps drifting after the cursor leaves. Short (0.2) = snappy, long (2.0) = smoky.

trailSpacing.title: Wake Sample Spacing
trailSpacing.description: Minimum cursor travel (world units) before a new sample is recorded. Larger = a coarser, longer wake for the same number of samples. 0 = record every frame.

pushAlong.title: Push: Along stroke
pushAlong.description: Shoves motes in the DIRECTION THE CURSOR IS TRAVELLING. This is the ingredient that kills the "circular blast" look â keep it dominant.

pushSwirl.title: Push: Swirl
pushSwirl.description: Adds a sideways curl perpendicular to the stroke, so the wake rolls instead of shoving flatly. Small amounts read as turbulence.

pushOut.title: Push: Outward
pushOut.description: The OLD radial away-from-cursor push, kept only as a garnish so motes don't pile up on the cursor line. Turning this up re-creates the ugly symmetric bubble â keep it low.

trailFadeIn.title: Wake Fade-In (s)
trailFadeIn.description: Each wake sample ramps up to full strength over this many seconds instead of appearing at once. Cures the visible position "pop" when the cursor moves slowly (samples land sparsely); too high makes the wake feel laggy behind the cursor.

density.title: Block Density
density.description: How many city blocks fit across the map height (blocks are kept square using the map aspect).

jitter.title: Street Irregularity
jitter.description: How far minor streets wander off the perfect grid. Keep low so the city reads as a grid, not a maze. Avenues stay much straighter.

lineWidth.title: Line Width
lineWidth.description: Thickness of the hot core of a minor street, in block units.

breakFreq.title: Break Frequency
breakFreq.description: How often a minor street is chopped into segments along its length. Higher = shorter dashes. Avenues never break.

breakAmount.title: Broken Segments
breakAmount.description: Fraction of minor street segments that are missing, so the grid feels incomplete. 0 = solid streets.

nodeSize.title: Node Size
nodeSize.description: Radius of the glowing nodes that bloom at intersections (block units).

nodeDensity.title: Node Density
nodeDensity.description: Fraction of intersections that grow a node. 1 = every crossing lights up.

secondary.title: Secondary Links
secondary.description: Strength of the faint diagonal connections that flash briefly at the wavefront. 0 = off.

centerEntity.title: Pulse Centre
centerEntity.description: Entity the pulse originates from (e.g. the diamond). Its live world position is transformed into this plane's surface UV, so the pulse fires exactly where the entity sits on the map â through any group tilt/rotation/pan.

centerU.title: Manual Centre U
centerU.description: Fallback pulse origin across the map (0..1) when no Pulse Centre entity is assigned.

centerV.title: Manual Centre V
centerV.description: Fallback pulse origin up the map (0..1) when no Pulse Centre entity is assigned.

pulseSpeed.title: Launch Speed
pulseSpeed.description: INITIAL expansion speed of the wavefront (map-heights per second). The wave launches at this speed and decelerates toward its outer reach (see Deceleration).

attack.title: Node Delay
attack.description: Seconds after the front passes before an intersection node reaches full flare (the nodes pop just behind the line).

trail.title: Fade Trail
trail.description: How long the glow lingers behind the wavefront before fading out (seconds). Larger = longer comet-tail of light.

edgeBoost.title: Crest Brightness
edgeBoost.description: Extra brightness of the leading crest. Scales with the front's CURRENT speed â fierce at launch, gone when the wave exhausts.

master.title: Master Intensity
master.description: Overall emissive strength of the whole effect.

triggerEvent.title: Trigger Event
triggerEvent.description: EventBus event that also fires a pulse: EventBus.emit('infra:pulse'). Leave empty to disable.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Keep re-firing pulses on a timer, for an ambient living-grid feel. With "Trigger On Scroll" the loop only runs while past the trigger.

loopInterval.title: Loop Interval (s)
loopInterval.description: Time between successive pulse births (NOT a gap after the last one finishes). Small values overlap a new pulse on top of the previous, still-fading one. Clamped to ~0.15s minimum.

haloScale.title: Glow Softness
haloScale.description: How far the soft halo spreads beyond the core (Ã line width). Higher = softer, more thread-like glow.

avenueEvery.title: Avenue Spacing
avenueEvery.description: Every Nth line is a major avenue: straighter, wider, brighter and unbroken. Gives the city a road hierarchy instead of a uniform maze.

avenueWidth.title: Avenue Width
avenueWidth.description: How much wider major avenues are than minor streets.

avenueBright.title: Avenue Brightness
avenueBright.description: How much brighter major avenues are than minor streets.

coverScale.title: District Scale
coverScale.description: Size of the developed "districts". Lower = larger sprawling districts; higher = smaller patches.

coverThreshold.title: District Coverage
coverThreshold.description: How much of the map is built up. Higher = more empty land and rougher, more broken-up edges (never a full rectangle).

edgeFeather.title: Edge Feather
edgeFeather.description: Small safety fade toward the plane border (a backstop â the irregular Pulse Reach below is what really keeps the shape off the edges).

frontJitter.title: Wavefront Raggedness
frontJitter.description: How uneven the advancing front is â some districts light up earlier than others, so the reveal is never a clean circle. 0 = perfect ring.

frontScale.title: Raggedness Scale
frontScale.description: Size of the lobes in the ragged front (plane-space â broad coherent bulges, not per-block speckle). Lower = big sweeping lobes; higher = more fingered edge.

colorSpeed.title: Colour Flow Speed
colorSpeed.description: How fast the amber/gold/white variation travels along the streets.

mapAspect.title: Aspect (0 = auto)
mapAspect.description: Width / height used to keep blocks square & the wave circular. 0 auto-uses the plane's world scale (X/Z) â correct on the tilted surface. Override only if the plane's UVs aren't a clean unit square and blocks look stretched.

boundRadius.title: Pulse Reach
boundRadius.description: How far the pulse reaches from the centre (in map heights). Keep below ~0.5 so the glow stops well before the plane edges instead of filling the rectangle.

boundJitter.title: Reach Irregularity
boundJitter.description: How much the reach varies by direction, so the outer boundary is an abstract blob that ends at different margins per side â never a rectangle. 0 = a clean circle.

boundLobes.title: Reach Lobes
boundLobes.description: How many bulges the irregular boundary has. Lower = a few big lobes; higher = a more fingered outline.

boundSoft.title: Reach Softness
boundSoft.description: How softly the glow dissolves at its outer boundary.

triggerProgress.title: Trigger at Scroll Progress
triggerProgress.description: Scroll progress (0..1) at which the pulse starts (e.g. 0.21, as the diamond lands). Scrolling back below it stops the loop and re-arms.

debug.title: Debug Centre
debug.description: Log the computed pulse-centre UV to the console each time a pulse fires, to help dial in the centre / flips.

mapEntity.title: Map (satelliteFeed)
mapEntity.description: The map entity carrying satelliteFeed. Its live texture-pan is read and applied as a direct UV offset so the grid PATTERN drifts with the map. Parent this grid plane INTO the map group so it rotates with the map; the pan is layered on top. Leave empty to disable.

mapPanStrength.title: Map Lock Strength
mapPanStrength.description: 1 = grid sticks exactly to the map pan. <1 lets the grid lag for a parallax feel. 0 = ignore the pan.

invertMapPanX.title: Invert Map Lock X
invertMapPanX.description: Flip if the grid pattern slides the wrong way horizontally when you pan the map.

invertMapPanY.title: Invert Map Lock Y
invertMapPanY.description: Flip if the grid pattern slides the wrong way vertically when you pan the map.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the Pulse Centre to screen. Auto-detected (first enabled, non-render-target camera) if left empty.

easeOut.title: Deceleration
easeOut.description: How strongly the wave slows as it travels. 1 = constant speed (the old behaviour); higher = a hard fast launch that dies out at the edge â the energy visibly exhausts.

frontSoftness.title: Front Softness
frontSoftness.description: Spatial width of the switch-on band at the wavefront (map-heights). Streets fade in across this distance, so the edge is always smooth â no burnt/pixelly rim.

crestWidth.title: Crest Width
crestWidth.description: Spatial width of the bright leading edge (map-heights). Drives the crest boost & secondary links.

impactStrength.title: Impact Flash
impactStrength.description: Brightness of the hot bloom at the origin the instant a pulse is born â the "data lands here" moment. 0 = off.

impactTime.title: Impact Decay (s)
impactTime.description: How fast the impact flash burns off after the pulse is born.

matchLens.title: Match Lens Ripple
matchLens.description: Mirror ONLY the cursor lens's normal-map ripple onto the grid (same influence blob, same phase), so the relief shows on top of the grid too. The grid is NOT lens-distorted â no fisheye, no magnify. All values are read live from the Map (satelliteFeed) entity; there are no duplicate sliders here.

matchLensAmount.title: Ripple Match Amount
matchLensAmount.description: 1 = ripple the grid exactly as much as the map. <1 = subtler on the grid; >1 = exaggerates it.

holeMarginX.title: Hole Side Margin (px)
holeMarginX.description: Gap from each screen side to the hole, BEFORE clamping. The hole width = viewport â 2Ãthis, clamped to the min/max below.

holeMarginY.title: Hole Top/Bottom Margin (px)
holeMarginY.description: Gap from the top & bottom to the hole, BEFORE clamping.

cornerMarginX.title: Corner Cross Inset X (px)
cornerMarginX.description: How far the corner registration crosses sit in from the left/right screen edges.

cornerMarginY.title: Corner Cross Inset Y (px)
cornerMarginY.description: How far the corner crosses sit in from the top/bottom screen edges.

triggerProgress.title: Reveal At (progress)
triggerProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the HUD fades in (match the text). Set both reveal/fade-out to keep it up for the whole map view.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to make the HUD stick to the map. With it, the HUD follows the map's on-screen movement and scrolls away with the scene instead of staying fixed under the next scene. Without it, the HUD stays fixed to the viewport.

trackTarget.title: Track Target (the map)
trackTarget.description: Entity the HUD sticks to (the map plane). Defaults to this entity.

activate.title: Activation Animation
activate.description: Play a one-shot "powering-on" animation when the HUD first appears (the target opens and the corner ticks blink in) instead of a plain fade. Replays each time it re-enters.

openDuration.title: Target Open Time (s)
openDuration.description: How long the hole + side line-work take to spread from contracted to full size.

openScale.title: Target Start Size
openScale.description: How contracted the hole starts (fraction of full). 1 = no opening move; lower = the target opens from further in.

blinkCount.title: Corner Tick Blinks
blinkCount.description: How many times the 4 corner registration crosses blink as they switch on.

blinkInterval.title: Corner Blink Interval (s)
blinkInterval.description: On/off period of each corner-tick blink.

refViewportW.title: Full-Size Min Width (px)
refViewportW.description: Viewport width at/above which the HUD renders at 1:1. Narrower windows scale the whole HUD down proportionally so nothing overflows.

refViewportH.title: Full-Size Min Height (px)
refViewportH.description: Viewport height at/above which the HUD renders at 1:1. Shorter windows scale the HUD down.

minScale.title: Min HUD Scale
minScale.description: The HUD never shrinks below this fraction of full size, however small the window.

startProgress.title: Fire At (scroll progress)
startProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the single ring impulse fires. Re-arms when you scroll back below it.

duration.title: Impulse Time (s)
duration.description: How long one ring takes to expand from the centre and fully fade.

maxRadius.title: Reach
maxRadius.description: How far the ring travels before it dies. 1 â the plane's vertical edge; ~1.4 reaches the corners.

startRadius.title: Start Radius
startRadius.description: Where the ring is born. 0 = the exact centre.

ringWidth.title: Ring Softness
ringWidth.description: Thickness / softness of the ring band. Lower = a tighter, crisper ring.

widthGrow.title: Dissipate
widthGrow.description: How much the ring softens as it expands, so it naturally dissolves at the end. 0 = constant width.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: Peak intensity of the ring at birth. Keep it low for a subtle pulse.

decay.title: Fade Curve
decay.description: How quickly the ring dims as it expands. Higher = fades out earlier in its travel.

additive.title: Additive (glow)
additive.description: ON = the ring adds light (a clean energy pulse). OFF = normal alpha blend (the ring tints toward its colour instead).

aspect.title: Aspect (0 = auto)
aspect.description: Keeps the ring circular. 0 auto-measures the PLANE's on-screen width/height (so it stays a circle at any browser size). Override with a fixed number only if the auto-measure is off (e.g. a tilted plane).

normalMap.title: Normal Map (optional)
normalMap.description: Surface detail painted onto the ring only. Set the texture to repeat. Leave empty for a clean ring.

normalScale.title: Normal Tiling
normalScale.description: How many times the normal map repeats across the plane.

normalStrength.title: Normal Relief
normalStrength.description: How much the normal map ripples the ring band (in/out along the radius). 0 = flat.

normalSpeed.title: Normal Drift
normalSpeed.description: How fast the normal-map pattern scrolls while the ring lives. 0 = frozen.

normalShade.title: Normal Shading
normalShade.description: How strongly the normal map lights/darkens the ring as relief. 0 = no shading (only the radius ripple).

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to measure the plane's on-screen shape for the auto aspect. Auto-detected (first enabled, non-render-target camera) if left empty.

anchorOffset.title: Glint Offset (local)
anchorOffset.description: Local-space offset on the target where the flare originates (e.g. a panel corner). 0 = the target origin.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the target to screen. Auto-detected (first enabled, non-render-target camera) if empty.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Overall strength of the flare. Keep modest for subtlety.

parallaxShift.title: Flare Drift (px)
parallaxShift.description: How far the flare origin eases with the cursor, on top of the satellite's own parallax.

mouseIntensity.title: Mouse Brightness
mouseIntensity.description: How much the cursor near the glint brightens the flare. 0 = constant.

smoothing.title: Drift Smoothing
smoothing.description: Easing of the cursor-driven drift. Lower = more lag/float.

tint.title: Flare Tint (warm)
tint.description: Base colour the whole flare is multiplied by.

trackTarget.title: Track Target (the satellite)
trackTarget.description: Entity the flare originates from. Defaults to this entity. If none resolves, the flare follows the cursor.

flareSize.title: Flare Size
flareSize.description: Overall scale of the whole flare around screen centre. Lower = smaller/tighter, higher = bigger.

contrast.title: Shape Contrast
contrast.description: Punches the ghosts out of the haze. >1 = crisper, more defined shapes; <1 = softer, more glow.

colorWash.title: Colour Wash
colorWash.description: How much the bright parts wash toward white. Lower = richer, more colourful; higher = whiter/cleaner.

chroma.title: Chromatic Spread
chroma.description: Separation of the R/G/B ghosts. 0 = no colour fringing (mono); 1 = original; higher = more rainbow split.

layerName.title: Render Layer
layerName.description: Layer the fullscreen flare draws on. It is forced to sort LAST (on top) within that layer; if it still appears behind something, set this to the layer that something is on (or a top overlay layer).

revealStart.title: Reveal At (progress)
revealStart.description: Scroll progress at which the flare is fully in. It fades IN over the smoothness band just before this.

revealEnd.title: Fade Out At (progress)
revealEnd.description: Scroll progress at which the flare starts fading OUT (over the smoothness band after it). Set to 1 to never fade out.

revealFade.title: Fade Smoothness (progress)
revealFade.description: How much scroll the fade in/out takes â the higher, the softer/longer the fade.

sizeMode.title: Size Mode
sizeMode.description: Responsive = title/subtitle sizes are a FRACTION of the viewport height (scales with the screen, mobile-friendly). Fixed = world units (like worldText).

titleSize.title: Title Size
titleSize.description: Responsive: fraction of viewport height (0.06 = 6%). Fixed: world units.

subtitleSize.title: Subtitle Size
subtitleSize.description: Responsive: fraction of viewport height. Fixed: world units.

maxWidthFraction.title: Max Width (fraction of viewport)
maxWidthFraction.description: Responsive mode only: the block shrinks to never exceed this fraction of the viewport WIDTH, so it never overflows on narrow/mobile screens. 1 = no clamp.

screenX.title: Screen X (0 = left, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right)
screenX.description: No Stick-To target: absolute horizontal screen position. With a target: a horizontal OFFSET from it (0.5 = on the target, lower = left, higher = right).

screenY.title: Screen Y (0 = top, 0.5 = middle, 1 = bottom)
screenY.description: No Stick-To target: absolute vertical screen position. With a target: a vertical OFFSET from it (0.5 = on the target).

distance.title: Distance from camera (set BEYOND the satellite so it occludes the text)

occlusionBias.title: Occlusion Bias (world units; raise if the satellite edge flickers)

occlusionInvert.title: Invert Occlusion (tick if it hides in the open / shows through the satellite)

fade.title: Fade length (progress units) â the "fade time", sharpâblur happens across this

trackTarget.title: Stick To (world entity, e.g. the video)
trackTarget.description: If set, the text STICKS to this world entity (like sceneText sticks to the map): it scrolls away as the camera moves down, and the satellite's parallax never drags it. The text stays at the constant camera Distance (so the satellite still occludes it) and a constant on-screen size â it just follows the target's screen position. Leave empty to pin to a fixed Screen X/Y instead.

fadeBlur.title: Fade Blur (max)
fadeBlur.description: Blur at the transparent end of the fade. The text animates sharp+opaque â blurred+transparent across the Fade length above. 0 = plain opacity fade (no blur).

fadeInTime.title: Intro Fade-In Time (s)
fadeInTime.description: TIME-based fade-in (with the same blur) that plays once the CTA starts the experience â needed because scroll progress is pinned at 0 during the satellite fly-in, so the progress window can't ramp it. 0 = appear instantly. The fade-OUT is still driven by the scroll window above.

mobileBreakpoint.title: Mobile Â· Breakpoint (px)
mobileBreakpoint.description: Viewport width at/below which every Mobile value below is used.

offsetXMobile.title: Mobile Â· Offset X (world units; + = right)

offsetYMobile.title: Mobile Â· Offset Y (world units; + = up)

lineHeightMobile.title: Mobile Â· Title Line Height (Ã font size)

titleSizeMobile.title: Mobile Â· Title Size
titleSizeMobile.description: Replaces Title Size (same units as the current Size Mode).

subtitleSizeMobile.title: Mobile Â· Body Size
subtitleSizeMobile.description: Replaces Subtitle Size (same units as the current Size Mode).

subtitleLineHeightMobile.title: Mobile Â· Body Line Height (Ã font size)

hoverEnabled.title: Cursor Blur Â· Enable
hoverEnabled.description: Blur + dissolve the text around the mouse (the textblur effect). Off = unchanged.

hoverBlur.title: Cursor Blur Â· Strength
hoverBlur.description: Extra blur (mip levels) added at the cursor. 0 disables the hover blur.

hoverRadius.title: Cursor Blur Â· Radius
hoverRadius.description: Reach of the cursor influence, in screen-height units (0.5 = the textblur default).

hoverEase.title: Cursor Blur Â· Ease (per second)
hoverEase.description: How fast the blur spot chases the cursor. 0 = locked to it.

hoverBlurStrength.title: Cursor Blur Â· Dissolve Threshold
hoverBlurStrength.description: Blur level past which the text dissolves under the cursor (textblur's Blur Strength).

hoverMinOpacity.title: Cursor Blur Â· Min Opacity
hoverMinOpacity.description: Floor of the dissolve under the cursor. 0 = disappears completely, 1 = never dissolves (blur only).

subtitleUppercase.title: Body Â· Uppercase
subtitleUppercase.description: Render the body text in UPPERCASE (the title is untouched).

bodyIcon.title: Body Â· Cross Icon
bodyIcon.description: Draw a thin plus/cross to the left of the body, its left edge aligned with the title. Inherits the Text Colour.

bodyIconSize.title: Body Â· Icon Size (Ã body size)

bodyIconGap.title: Body Â· Icon â Text Gap (Ã body size)

hoverPadding.title: Cursor Blur Â· Edge Padding (Ã title size)
hoverPadding.description: Transparent margin baked around the text so the hover blur fades out before the texture edge â too little and the smeared white text clips there, showing a frame around the quad. Raise if you still see an edge at high blur. Only used while Cursor Blur is enabled.

maxWidthFractionMobile.title: Mobile Â· Max Width (fraction of viewport)
maxWidthFractionMobile.description: Responsive mode only: shrinks the whole block so it never exceeds this fraction of the viewport WIDTH (mobile version of Max Width). Scales the text down â it does NOT reflow it. 1 = no clamp.

bodyWrapChars.title: Body Wrap (characters per line)
bodyWrapChars.description: Word-WRAPS the body to at most this many characters per line. 0 = off (only \n breaks). Applies to the body only; the title never wraps. Try ~34â40 for a phone paragraph.

bodyWrapCharsMobile.title: Mobile Â· Body Wrap (characters per line)
bodyWrapCharsMobile.description: Replaces Body Wrap at/below the breakpoint. Word-wraps the body to this many characters per line. 0 = off. Try ~34 for a phone paragraph.

hoverTrailTime.title: Cursor Blur Â· Trail Fade (s)
hoverTrailTime.description: A second, slower-chasing blur echo that lags behind the cursor and keeps fading where it used to be, instead of the blur snapping off the instant the cursor leaves. Value = roughly how many seconds the echo takes to catch up (bigger = longer lingering trail). 0 = off â reverts byte-for-byte to the original single-point blur.

scrambleEnabled.title: Intro Scramble Â· Enable
scrambleEnabled.description: Decode/scramble each glyph in when the text appears (title + body). Off = plain fade-in.

scrambleDuration.title: Intro Scramble Â· Duration (s)
scrambleDuration.description: How long the full decode takes. Glyphs resolve staggered left-to-right within this time.

scrambleChars.title: Intro Scramble Â· Character set
scrambleChars.description: Pool of random glyphs shown before each character resolves.

scrambleFadeSync.title: Intro Scramble Â· Fade in with decode
scrambleFadeSync.description: Run the intro opacity fade-in over the Scramble Duration (instead of Intro Fade-In Time) so the title + body fade in exactly as they decode â starting and finishing together. Off = the fade uses Intro Fade-In Time independently.

horizonY.title: Horizon Y
horizonY.description: Vertical position of the horizon line (0 = top, 1 = bottom in shader space). Sky/aurora above, water reflection below.

vanishX.title: Vanishing-point X
vanishX.description: Horizontal position the aurora band radiates from. 0.5 = centred.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity multiplier (on top of the scroll gate).

flipY.title: Flip Vertical
flipY.description: Flip the V axis. Toggle if the aurora appears upside-down on your plane.

gateOnScroll.title: Gate On Scroll
gateOnScroll.description: Off = always fully visible (ignores the progress window below).

progressStart.title: Progress START
progressStart.description: Scroll progress at which the aurora begins to appear (ChipScene start).

progressEnd.title: Progress END
progressEnd.description: Scroll progress at which the aurora is fully gone again. Set to 1 to keep it for the rest of the scroll.

progressFade.title: Edge fade (progress)
progressFade.description: How much of the window is spent fading in at START and out at END.

animSpeed.title: Anim Speed
animSpeed.description: How fast the aurora shimmers/flows and the glow breathes. 0 = frozen (the original static look).

shimmer.title: Shimmer Amount
shimmer.description: Depth of the brightness ripple flowing along the curtain. 0 = smooth band, 1 = strong flicker.

shimmerScale.title: Shimmer Scale
shimmerScale.description: How many ripples run along the band. Higher = finer, busier shimmer.

intensity.title: Aurora Intensity
intensity.description: Master brightness/opacity of the aurora band.

horizonLineWidth.title: Horizon Line Width
horizonLineWidth.description: Half-thickness of the crisp horizon line. Lower = thinner.

horizonGlowSize.title: Horizon Glow Size
horizonGlowSize.description: Reach of the tight glow hugging the horizon.

horizonWideSize.title: Horizon Wide Size
horizonWideSize.description: Reach of the broad soft halo above the horizon (left side).

bloomSize.title: Bloom Size
bloomSize.description: Radius of the bright burst at the vanishing point. Lower = smaller.

mirror.title: Mirror (symmetrical)
mirror.description: Reflect the aurora band about the vanishing-point X so it appears symmetrically on both the left and right. Off = original right-side-only curtain.

centerFade.title: Center Fade Radius
centerFade.description: Fades the aurora out near the vanishing point so the curtains do NOT all pinch into a single point. 0 = lights converge to a point (original); higher = larger soft empty core.

mobileQuality.title: Mobile Quality
mobileQuality.description: Cheaper shimmer for phones: a single 2-octave noise instead of two 4-octave noises (the shader's main cost, ~75% less). Barely changes the look. NOTE: this only cuts ALU; the bigger mobile cost is fill-rate (it runs per screen pixel) â keep the plane no larger than it needs to be.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: How far into the field you look. Source zooms to the middle fifth (0.2), where the effect is most interesting. Lower = closer/larger lights.

colorPhase.title: Colour Phase
colorPhase.description: Per-channel hue offsets fed into cos() â shifts the colours of the lights. These are phases, not 0â1 colours (source: 1, 2, 3).

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Overall brightness multiplier of the lights.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity multiplier (on top of the scroll gate).

additive.title: Additive (glow over content)
additive.description: On: the lights ADD over whatever is behind (dark gaps contribute nothing) â best as a glow above a scene. Off: normal blend, an opaque background.

flipY.title: Flip Vertical
flipY.description: Flip the V axis (the field is roughly centred, so this mostly just reverses drift direction).

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Animation speed of the drifting/morphing lights. 0 = frozen.

octaves.title: Octaves (desktop)
octaves.description: Number of light layers accumulated. More = denser field of small lights, heavier. Source: 18.

mobileOctaves.title: Octaves (mobile)
mobileOctaves.description: Octave count used on phones (auto) or when Mobile Quality is forced on. Fewer = cheaper; drops some of the smallest lights.

mobileQuality.title: Force Mobile Quality
mobileQuality.description: Force the reduced octave count on every device (for testing the mobile look on desktop). Phones use it automatically regardless. NOTE: the main mobile cost is fill-rate â keep the plane no larger than needed, or render at half-res.

gateOnScroll.title: Gate On Scroll
gateOnScroll.description: Off = always fully visible (ignores the progress window below).

progressStart.title: Progress START
progressStart.description: Scroll progress at which the effect begins to appear.

progressEnd.title: Progress END
progressEnd.description: Scroll progress at which the effect is fully gone again. Set to 1 to keep it for the rest of the scroll.

progressFade.title: Edge fade (progress)
progressFade.description: How much of the window is spent fading in at START and out at END.

debug.title: Debug (console)
debug.description: Log lifecycle + visibility to the console to diagnose why it may not show: render component found, mesh count, shader built, mobile detection, EventBus subscription, and the scroll-gate alpha each time it changes. Turn on, open the console, reload.

organicFadeIn.title: Organic Fade-In
organicFadeIn.description: Reveal the nebula through a noise-warped front (grows in) instead of a flat opacity ramp. Off = the original uniform fade-in.

revealFromCenter.title: Reveal From Centre
revealFromCenter.description: On: the reveal grows OUT from the centre (a core that blooms outward). Off: it closes IN from the edges toward the centre.

revealNoiseScale.title: Reveal Noise Scale
revealNoiseScale.description: Higher = finer, busier speckle along the revealing front.

revealOrganic.title: Reveal Organic Amount
revealOrganic.description: 0 = clean circular front. Higher = more warped / uneven reveal.

revealEdge.title: Reveal Edge Softness
revealEdge.description: Width of the fading boundary between hidden and revealed.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: How far into the field you look. Lower = closer/larger lights. Matches nebula.js semantics (default 0.2).

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Overall brightness multiplier of the whole effect (field + sun).

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity multiplier (on top of the scroll gate).

additive.title: Additive (glow over content)
additive.description: On: the effect ADDS over whatever is behind (dark gaps contribute nothing) â best as a glow above a scene. Off: normal blend, an opaque background.

flipY.title: Flip Vertical
flipY.description: Flip the V axis (mostly just reverses drift direction).

sunSize.title: Sun Size
sunSize.description: Radius of the sun body in screen units (independent of Zoom).

sunColor.title: Sun Colour
sunColor.description: Base colour of the sun body, core and halo.

sunIntensity.title: Sun Intensity
sunIntensity.description: Brightness of the sun on top of the global Brightness. 0 = no sun at all (pure nebula field).

sunCoreSize.title: Sun Core Size
sunCoreSize.description: Radius of the ultra-bright inner core (the white-hot centre). Smaller = tighter, hotter point.

sunEdge.title: Sun Edge Softness
sunEdge.description: Width of the fuzzy boundary of the sun body. Larger = softer, more flame-like rim.

sunMorphAmount.title: Sun Organic Amount
sunMorphAmount.description: How far the noise field deforms the sun. 0 = a plain disc. Higher = a shapeless organic glow with no readable circle â the whole sun (core, body, halo) follows the warped field, same idea as the Organic Fade-In front.

sunMorphSpeed.title: Sun Morph Speed
sunMorphSpeed.description: How fast the outer shape re-forms. 0 = frozen (but the shape is still irregular). Size and brightness never change â only the outline.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Animation speed of the drifting/morphing lights. 0 = frozen field (the sun still morphs on its own speeds).

mobileQuality.title: Force Mobile Quality
mobileQuality.description: Force the reduced octave count on every device (for testing the mobile look on desktop). Phones use it automatically regardless.

debug.title: Debug (console)
debug.description: Log lifecycle + visibility to the console (render component, mesh count, shader built, mobile detection, EventBus, scroll-gate alpha).

gateOnScroll.title: Gate On Scroll
gateOnScroll.description: Off = always fully visible (ignores the progress window below).

progressStart.title: Progress START
progressStart.description: Scroll progress at which the effect begins to appear.

progressEnd.title: Progress END
progressEnd.description: Scroll progress at which the effect is fully gone again. Set to 1 to keep it for the rest of the scroll.

organicFadeIn.title: Organic Fade-In
organicFadeIn.description: Reveal through a noise-warped front (grows in) instead of a flat opacity ramp. Off = uniform fade-in.

revealFromCenter.title: Reveal From Centre
revealFromCenter.description: On: the reveal blooms OUT from the centre. Off: it closes IN from the edges.

revealNoiseScale.title: Reveal Noise Scale
revealNoiseScale.description: Higher = finer, busier speckle along the revealing front.

revealOrganic.title: Reveal Organic Amount
revealOrganic.description: 0 = clean circular front. Higher = more warped / uneven reveal.

revealEdge.title: Reveal Edge Softness
revealEdge.description: Width of the fading boundary between hidden and revealed.

colorPhase.title: Colour Phase
colorPhase.description: Per-channel hue offsets fed into cos() â shifts the colours of the lights AND tints the base haze (the accumulation is seeded with this). These are phases, not 0â1 colours.

octaves.title: Octaves (desktop)
octaves.description: Number of light layers accumulated. More = denser field of small lights, heavier.

mobileOctaves.title: Octaves (mobile)
mobileOctaves.description: Octave count used on phones (auto) or when Mobile Quality is forced on. Fewer = cheaper; drops some of the smallest lights.

haze.title: Base Haze
haze.description: Flat base fog level (the accumulator seed). 0 = pitch-black background between lights; 1 = the milky uniform haze of the original. Keep low for a dark nebula where the only background colour comes from the ember patches.

ember.title: Ember Patches
ember.description: Strength of the wide, dim fog patches around each light â the faded residue of lights tinting the darkness in warm/cool gradients (the non-uniform background colours). 0 = none.

swirl.title: Smoke Patches
swirl.description: Localized background smoke: a slow drifting mask picks random regions of the screen, and only inside them a domain-warped haze curls smoothly like moving smoke. Independent of the lights, tinted by the Colour Phase palette. 0 = none.

lightAmount.title: Light Amount
lightAmount.description: How much of the field can ignite lights (the resonance amplitude against the gate ramp â it directly shrinks or grows the area where lights are allowed to appear). 0 = no lights at all, only haze; higher = lights over more of the screen.

sunNoiseScale.title: Sun Noise Scale
sunNoiseScale.description: Scale of the noise field that deforms the sun (same idea as Reveal Noise Scale). Lower = broad sweeping deformation; higher = finer, busier boundary.

tint.title: Tint (global cast)
tint.description: Multiplies the whole field â the reliable way to give the nebula an overall colour (e.g. amber/gold). Colour Phase only sets the palette of individual glints; because ~17 octaves average out, it can NOT bias the overall tone, so use this for the global cast. White (1,1,1) = no tint. Amber/gold â (1.0, 0.72, 0.38).

tintStrength.title: Tint Strength
tintStrength.description: How strongly the Tint is applied. 0 = ignore Tint (neutral); 1 = full tint. Lets bright cores keep some of their own colour at lower values.

roundedCorners.title: Rounded Corners
roundedCorners.description: Clip the plane into a rounded-rectangle card. Uses an SDF in the shader â perfect at any resolution, scales with the card.

cornerRadius.title: Corner Radius
cornerRadius.description: Corner radius as a fraction of the card's SHORTER side (0 = square, 0.5 = pill/stadium). Proportional, so one value works on mobile and desktop.

fadeInWidth.title: Fade-IN width (progress)
fadeInWidth.description: How much of the window is spent fading/dissolving IN at START (the organic reveal). Independent of the fade-out.

fadeOutWidth.title: Fade-OUT width (progress)
fadeOutWidth.description: How much of the window is spent fading OUT at END. Independent of the fade-in.

size.title: Effect Size (world units)
size.description: Half-size of the effect in world units â the dots' vertical reach and horizontal spread scale off this. Set to roughly the chip half-size. Ignored if Chip Entity is set (auto-measured).

chipEntity.title: Chip Entity (optional)
chipEntity.description: If set, the effect auto-measures this entity's size ONCE and centres on it (following it while it exists). Leave empty to centre on THIS entity and use Effect Size.

lineCount.title: Dot Columns
lineCount.description: How many vertical columns of dots span the width. Each column emits an UP stream and a DOWN stream from the centre line. They ignite one by one as the effect expands.

dotsPerLine.title: Dots / Line
dotsPerLine.description: How many dots are strung along each line (per direction). Higher = a denser, clearer dotted line â matrix.js uses ~22.

dotSize.title: Dot Size (Ã size)
dotSize.description: Dot radius as a fraction of Effect Size. Matches matrix.js glints visually at ~0.04â0.06.

dotColor.title: Dot Colour
dotColor.description: Same default as matrix.js Glint Colour so the handoff matches.

flow.title: Stream Speed
flow.description: How fast the dots travel outward along their lines (continuous stream â new dots keep being born at the centre).

edgeScale.title: Reach (Ã size)
edgeScale.description: How far the dots travel VERTICALLY from the centre line, as a multiple of Effect Size. 1 = the top/bottom edge.

spread.title: Width Spread (Ã size)
spread.description: How wide the vertical columns of dots fan out horizontally. 1 â Effect Size.

coreStrength.title: Core Glow Strength
coreStrength.description: Soft bloom at the centre â rises while the dots emerge, dies as they contract. 0 = none.

dissolveStart.title: Dissolve Start
dissolveStart.description: Dots begin emerging from the centre; the OUTER front expands toward the edges.

dissolveEnd.title: Dissolve End
dissolveEnd.description: Dots have reached the edge (match the chip's Dissolve End). The contraction begins here.

dotsFadeEnd.title: Dots Contract End
dotsFadeEnd.description: From Dissolve End to here the dots CONTRACT: the centre empties first and the streams shrink to the far edge and vanish. On a sceneChip entity this can run well past 0.57 (up to ~0.71).

debug.title: Debug (console)
debug.description: Log build + visibility to the console.

uiCamera.title: UI Camera
uiCamera.description: The perspective camera that captures the deck (the one with screenRenderTarget.js). Required â its FOV + distance to the deck set the world scale.

cardAspect.title: Card Aspect (W Ã· H)
cardAspect.description: Locked card shape as widthÃ·height. 16:9 = 1.7778. Height is derived from the responsive width.

cardCount.title: Card Count (incl. SceneChip #0)
cardCount.description: Total slots in the deck, counting the SceneChip card as #0. Consumers use this for centring and the scroll extent.

mobileMaxCss.title: Mobile breakpoint (css px)
mobileMaxCss.description: Canvas CSS width at/below which the Mobile width fraction & gap apply.

tabletMaxCss.title: Tablet breakpoint (css px)
tabletMaxCss.description: Canvas CSS width at/below which the Tablet width fraction applies (above Mobile).

widthFracMobile.title: Card width â Mobile (vw)
widthFracMobile.description: Card width as a fraction of viewport width on phones. 0.85 leaves a peek of the neighbouring cards.

widthFracDesktop.title: Card width â Desktop (vw)
widthFracDesktop.description: Desktop width as a fraction of viewport width, capped by the max below (i.e. min(cap, vw)).

desktopMaxCss.title: Card width â Desktop cap (css px)
desktopMaxCss.description: Upper bound on desktop card width in CSS px, so the card never gets huge on wide monitors (min(this, vw)).

gapMobilePx.title: Gap â Mobile (css px)
gapMobilePx.description: Constant pixel gap between cards on phones. Converted to world units per screen so it stays a fixed on-screen distance.

autoPosition.title: Auto-position children on X
autoPosition.description: Set each direct child card's local X to iÂ·P (Y/Z preserved) on init and every resize. Turn off to place cards yourself and only consume the metrics.

sizeCards.title: Size children to W Ã H
sizeCards.description: Scale each direct child card to the responsive card width W and height H, so the whole deck (and the SceneChip card) reads as one size. Off = position only; you apply sizing yourself from the card:layout event.

cardWidthAxis.title: Card width axis (local)
cardWidthAxis.description: Which LOCAL axis of each card is its width. Standard PlayCanvas plane (lies in XZ) â X.

cardHeightAxis.title: Card height axis (local)
cardHeightAxis.description: Which LOCAL axis is height. Standard PlayCanvas plane (XZ) â Z. A camera-facing plane (XY) â Y. Must match how your card meshes are built.

cardsGroup.title: Cards Group (cards 1..N)
cardsGroup.description: The scrolling deck group this card locks onto once card #1 is one pitch away. Must share a parent with card #0.

followPitches.title: Follow gap (pitches)
followPitches.description: How many card pitches card #1 sits ahead of card #0 at lock. 1 = one card+gap (card #1 is the group's first child). Change only if card #1 is not the group's first slot.

sizeToDeck.title: Size to deck (W Ã H)
sizeToDeck.description: Scale card #0 to the deck's responsive card size so it matches cards 1..N. Uses the same width/height axes as CardSystem.

autoCenter.title: Auto-centre under UI camera
autoCenter.description: Ignore the authored X and rest card #0 exactly on the deck's centre (the UICamera's central axis), so it can't be placed slightly off. On = the fix for a card that rests a few px off-centre. Assumes the UI camera looks straight down its forward axis.

lightColor.title: Light Colour A
lightColor.description: Colour of the first (lower) ribbon and the wash. Amber/gold â (1.0, 0.62, 0.26).

lightColor2.title: Light Colour B
lightColor2.description: Colour of the second ribbon. A lighter gold reads nicely against A.

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.description: Filmic exposure. Higher = the cores/crossing saturate toward white sooner.

baseY.title: Vertical Position
baseY.description: Where the ribbons sit. â1 = bottom, 0 = centre, 1 = top. The reference sits low (â â0.35).

separation.title: Ribbon Spread
separation.description: Vertical spread of the ribbon stack. Each ribbon drifts inside this band, so they periodically merge and separate.

arcAmplitude.title: Arc Amplitude
arcAmplitude.description: How far the ribbons rise and fall as they sweep across.

arcFrequency.title: Arc Frequency
arcFrequency.description: How many bends across the width. ~1.5 gives a single elegant sweep; higher = wavier.

arcCurve.title: Arc Bend
arcCurve.description: Pulls the ends down (a parabola) so the lines read as arcs peaking toward the centre. 0 = straight sine.

coreWidth.title: Line Width
coreWidth.description: Half-width of the bright core line. Small = a fine filament.

glowWidth.title: Glow Width
glowWidth.description: Radius of the soft glow around each ribbon.

horizontalFalloff.title: Horizontal Falloff
horizontalFalloff.description: How quickly the ribbons dim toward the left/right edges. 0 = full width, higher = tighter to centre.

washStrength.title: Surface Wash
washStrength.description: Dim amber light bleeding onto the "surface" below the arcs. 0 = none.

bloom.title: Convergence Bloom
bloom.description: Warm-white glow wherever several light sheets overlap (all pairs, not just two).

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Pace of the drift/breathe. 0 = frozen. Keep low for a calm wallpaper.

additive.title: Additive
additive.description: On: ADD over whatever is behind (glow over content). Off: an opaque background (the usual choice for a wallpaper).

gateOnScroll.title: Gate On Scroll
gateOnScroll.description: Off = always visible. On = fade in/out across the progress window below (e.g. only during SceneUI).

fadeWidth.title: Fade width (progress)
fadeWidth.description: How much of the window is spent fading in at START and out at END.

ribbonCount.title: Ribbon Count
ribbonCount.description: How many light sheets are layered. 4â5 reads as rich fabric; 2 = the old minimal look.

warpAmount.title: Organic Warp
warpAmount.description: How far drifting noise bends each ribbon away from a clean sine. 0 = geometric curves; higher = silk-like undulation.

warpScale.title: Warp Scale
warpScale.description: Frequency of the organic undulation. Lower = broad slow waves; higher = busier ripples.

energyFlow.title: Energy Variation
energyFlow.description: How much the brightness varies ALONG each ribbon (travelling hotspots). 0 = uniform line; 1 = strong pooling of light.

warmth.title: Warmth
warmth.description: Pulls the exposure white point toward candle-light so the hottest cores saturate to warm gold instead of electric white.

refCardWidthPx.title: Reference Card Width (css px)
refCardWidthPx.description: The desktop card width your px sizes below are designed for (matches cardSystem's Desktop cap). Everything scales relative to this.

imageWidthFrac.title: Image Width (fraction of card)
imageWidthFrac.description: Image width as a fraction of the card width. Height follows the PNG's own aspect.

imageMarginPx.title: Image Margin (px @ ref)
imageMarginPx.description: Inset of the image from the bottom-right corner. 0 = flush to the edges.

cornerRadius.title: Corner Radius
cornerRadius.description: Rounded-corner radius as a fraction of the shorter side. Same SDF as nebula2.

layerName.title: Layer (must match the deck / UICamera capture layer)

supersample.title: Text Crispness (Ã device px)
supersample.description: Text canvas resolution as a multiple of the card's size in DEVICE pixels (already dpr-aware). 1 = ~1:1 with the screen (sharpest, no double-downsample). Raise only if it still looks soft.

flipH.title: Flip Horizontal (if text is mirrored L/R)

flipV.title: Flip Vertical (if text is upside down)

frontOffset.title: Overlay Offset
frontOffset.description: How far in front of the glass the text/image sit (local units along the card normal), so they draw over it.

fillOpacity.title: Glass Opacity
fillOpacity.description: How opaque the card fill is. Low = the wallpaper shows through strongly (frosted look without the cost of a real blur).

glowWidth.title: Inner Glow Width
glowWidth.description: How far the glow reaches inward from the edges (fraction of the card half-height).

glowStrength.title: Inner Glow Strength
glowStrength.description: Brightness of the rim glow just inside the border. 0 = flat fill.

borderWidthPx.title: Border Width (css px)
borderWidthPx.description: Thickness of the border, in screen pixels relative to the card height. 0 = no border. Follows the rounded corners.

imageScale.title: Image Size (Ã)
imageScale.description: Overall size multiplier on top of Image Width â a quick knob to make the image bigger or smaller. Keeps the PNG's aspect.

hoverFillOpacity.title: Hover Glass Opacity
hoverFillOpacity.description: Glass fill opacity while hovered (eased from the normal Glass Opacity). Set above Glass Opacity so the card brightens on hover.

hoverLift.title: Hover Lift
hoverLift.description: How far the card moves toward the camera while hovered, in local Z units (the card's depth axis). Flip the sign if it sinks away instead of popping toward you.

hoverSpeed.title: Hover Easing
hoverSpeed.description: How fast the hover in/out animates. Lower = slower, more floaty.

hoverGlowStrength.title: Hover Glow Strength
hoverGlowStrength.description: Brightness of the radial glow at full hover. 0 = no glow.

hoverGlowRadius.title: Hover Glow Radius
hoverGlowRadius.description: How far the glow reaches from the card centre, in card half-height units (1 â the top/bottom edge; larger fills the corners).

hoverGlowGradient.title: Hover Glow Gradient
hoverGlowGradient.description: Falloff shape from centre to the radius. 1 = linear; higher = a tighter core with a softer, more gradual fade.

hoverGlowSmoothing.title: Hover Glow Smoothing
hoverGlowSmoothing.description: How much the glow lags the cursor. 0 = locked to the mouse (can feel stuck); higher = the glow eases toward the mouse with a soft trailing motion.

targetEntity.title: Target (defaults to this entity)
targetEntity.description: Root whose StandardMaterials get the scan. Leave empty to use the entity this script is on. Every render/model in its sub-tree is included.

radius.title: Base Radius
radius.description: Base scan size as a fraction of screen height, before the mouse-speed boost. Aspect-corrected so it reads round on any screen.

softness.title: Edge Softness
softness.description: Width of the smoothstep falloff from revealed to solid. Never a hard edge.

smoothing.title: Cursor Follow
smoothing.description: Easing of the stroke head following the cursor. 1 = locked to the mouse; lower adds a slight drag.

scanCamera.title: Scan Camera (defaults to the first camera)
scanCamera.description: The camera the scan is measured against â the one that renders the satellite. The mask projects world position through THIS camera, so it is identical in the forward AND shadow passes. Leave empty to auto-pick the first on-screen camera.

boundaryHaze.title: Edge Noise Amount
boundaryHaze.description: How far ONE low-frequency blurred value-noise (fbm) displaces the boundary â a soft irregular contour that slowly fluctuates. Keep low: subtle organic wobble, not smoke.

boundaryScale.title: Edge Noise Scale
boundaryScale.description: Frequency of the boundary noise. Low = broad, lazy undulation (recommended); high = busier contour.

speedRef.title: Speed Sensitivity
speedRef.description: Cursor speed (screen-widths per second) that produces the full effect. Lower = a gentle flick opens the full reveal; higher = you must move faster.

speedToSize.title: Speed â Radius
speedToSize.description: How much the reveal grows with cursor speed. 0 = constant size.

trailFade.title: Trail Fade (s)
trailFade.description: How long the reveal lingers behind the moving cursor before the shell closes back over it (the comet-tail length while moving).

frontAlpha.title: Front Face Alpha
frontAlpha.description: Opacity of camera-facing surfaces inside the reveal. ~0.08: the shell almost disappears, so the interior reads clearly.

backAlpha.title: Back Face Alpha
backAlpha.description: Opacity of away-facing surfaces (the inside of the far shell) inside the reveal. Higher than the front (~0.20) so the interior structure stays readable.

radiusSmoothing.title: Radius Grow Time (s)
radiusSmoothing.description: Time constant of the radius following the cursor speed. Higher = the reveal swells gradually instead of jumping to full size on a quick flick; it also shrinks back just as smoothly.

globalAlpha.title: Scan Alpha
globalAlpha.description: One multiplier on the reveal's opacity INSIDE the scan only: scales Front & Back Face Alpha together (outside the scan the satellite stays untouched). Lower = the scan area goes more see-through as a whole.

holeColor.title: Reveal Background Colour
holeColor.description: The colour painted BEHIND the satellite inside the reveal. The true background pixels never exist there (they were depth-rejected by the satellite's own silhouette), so this is what shows through the shell. Match it to your scene background (deep space navy, etc.).

revealBackground.title: Reveal Background (optional)
revealBackground.description: Entity (e.g. the earth/space background plane) RE-RENDERED inside the reveal, so the scan shows the real scene behind the satellite instead of the flat colour above. Its meshes are drawn again after the depth erase â geometry, material and video feed all stay live.

closeTime.title: Close Time (s)
closeTime.description: How slowly the reveal closes once the mouse STOPS â the visible glide of the circle shrinking/fading back to nothing. Higher = you watch it contract; low = it snaps shut. (Opening speed is unaffected.)

disableProgress.title: Disable At (scroll progress)
disableProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the scan is fully disabled. It does not vanish â the reveal radius shrinks to nothing over the fade band below, so a reveal in progress (mouse on the satellite) contracts away gracefully. Reversible: scrolling back up restores it.

disableFade.title: Disable Fade (progress)
disableFade.description: How much scroll BEFORE "Disable At" the reveal spends shrinking down. Larger = a longer, gentler contraction as you scroll.

excludeTag.title: Exclude Tag
excludeTag.description: Mesh entities carrying this tag (or a Glow script) are left OUT of the scan â never captured, cloned or material-swapped. Use it for self-managed / decorative materials parented under the satellite (e.g. a Glow plane), which the scan would otherwise clobber. Leave empty to auto-exclude only Glow objects.

additive.title: Additive
additive.description: Off (default): a translucent whitish veil OVER the scene, like the reference. On: pure glow added on top.

chroma.title: Chromatic Aberration
chroma.description: RGB split of the lattice along the local bend direction â the rainbow fringing lives exactly where the field curves.

pixelDensityA.title: Pixel Density A
pixelDensityA.description: Dots across the plane for the first lattice. High = fine screen-pixel structure.

pixelDensityB.title: Pixel Density B
pixelDensityB.description: Density of the SECOND lattice. Keep CLOSE to A (+5â¦15) â the small difference sets the moirÃ© band size (closer = bigger bands).

triggerProgress.title: Trigger Progress
triggerProgress.description: Scroll progress that FIRES the burst. Crossing it in EITHER direction (scrolling forward or back) launches â and always restarts â the effect.

duration.title: Duration (s)
duration.description: Total burst length once fired â independent of scroll speed.

fadeIn.title: Fade In (fraction)
fadeIn.description: Portion of the duration fading up at the start.

fadeOut.title: Fade Out (fraction)
fadeOut.description: Portion of the duration fading out at the end.

saturation.title: Rainbow Saturation
saturation.description: How coloured the RGB fringes are. 0 = grayscale lattice; ~0.8 = the pastel rainbow of the reference; >1 = punchy.

contrast.title: Lattice Contrast
contrast.description: How visible the dots are against the bright base. Low = a soft milky veil with faint structure; high = crisp visible pixels.

baseTint.title: Base Tint
baseTint.description: Colour of the bright veil the lattice sits in (the near-white of the reference).

veilOpacity.title: Veil Opacity
veilOpacity.description: Non-additive only: how much the veil covers the scene at full strength (the scene ghosts through at <1, like screenshot 2).

moireAngle.title: MoirÃ© Angle (deg)
moireAngle.description: Rotation of the second lattice against the first. A few degrees creates the classic curved interference swirls; 0 = only straight beat bands.

bendAmount.title: Bend Amount
bendAmount.description: How far the lattice is pushed by the curved field. SMALL values already curve the moirÃ© a lot â this displaces by whole pixels quickly.

bendFreq.title: Bend Count
bendFreq.description: How many bend periods span the screen (~how many "wraps" you see). ~3 matches the reference.

bendCurl.title: Bend Curl
bendCurl.description: Strength of the NESTED modulation. 0 = straight wavy lines; higher = the contours swirl into curls like the screenshots.

driftSpeed.title: Drift Speed
driftSpeed.description: How fast the bend field breathes/drifts while active (the "reacting to the camera" motion). 0 = frozen.

previewHold.title: PREVIEW: hold on
previewHold.description: Keeps the veil permanently visible so you can tweak parameters live. Turn OFF to restore the real triggerâplayâfade behaviour.
