fade.description: How long the in/out opacity fade takes at each end of a message window, in scroll-progress units.

width.title: Width (px)
width.description: Block width on desktop. On narrow screens it shrinks to fit the viewport automatically.

mobileFontSize.title: Mobile Font Size (px)
mobileFontSize.description: Font size below the mobile breakpoint.

mobileMarginTop.title: Mobile Â· Margin From Top (px)
mobileMarginTop.description: Top margin below the mobile breakpoint (replaces Margin From Top).

uiCamera.title: UI Camera
uiCamera.description: The camera that captures the deck (the one with screenRenderTarget.js). Required for picking.

hoverStart.title: Hover Start (progress)
hoverStart.description: Enable hover only from this scroll progress â the start of the full-screen SceneUI hold.

hoverEnd.title: Hover End (progress)
hoverEnd.description: Disable hover past this progress (the monitor stops being full-screen / the deck leaves).

videoAsset.title: Video Asset
videoAsset.description: Drop the uploaded video file here.

shapeMix.title: Shape: Box â Radial
shapeMix.description: 0 = box fade (uses the four Side widths). 1 = radial/elliptical fade (uses Radius). Mix between.

radiusX.title: Radius X
radiusX.description: Horizontal half-extent of the clear (video) region, in UV units. Radial mode only.

radiusY.title: Radius Y
radiusY.description: Vertical half-extent of the clear region. Set â  Radius X for an ellipse.

radialInner.title: Radial Core
radialInner.description: Fraction of the radius that stays fully video before the fade begins.

noiseScale.title: Noise Scale
noiseScale.description: Higher = finer, busier wobble along the fade contour.

organic.title: Organic Amount
organic.description: 0 = clean geometric fade. Higher = more warped / irregular contour.

edgeSoftness.title: Edge Softness
edgeSoftness.description: Width of the fade gradient. 1 = very soft/wide blend, low = sharper edge.

edgeFadeEnabled.title: Edge Fade Effect
edgeFadeEnabled.description: ON = dissolve the video edges to transparent (the organic fade below). OFF = show the raw video fully opaque, no transparency.

maxDpr.title: Max Pixel Ratio
maxDpr.description: Quality ceiling. 2 is the sweet spot: DPR 3 phones cannot show the difference but pay 2.25Ã the pixels.

minDpr.title: Min Pixel Ratio
minDpr.description: Adaptive floor. Below 1.0 the image goes soft on standard screens â only lower this if weak devices still cannot hold 1.0.

adaptive.title: Adaptive Scaling
adaptive.description: Step resolution down/up at runtime based on measured frame times.

coreColor.title: Core Colour (hot centre)
coreColor.description: The white/warm-white the brightest part reaches. Slightly warm reads as a hotter filament than pure white.

midColor.title: Mid Colour (amber)
midColor.description: The transition between the white core and the red rim.

edgeColor.title: Edge Colour (deep red)
edgeColor.description: The lens colour where the light is coolest (grazing angles).

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Overall emissive brightness. Above ~1 the core clears the bloom threshold and blooms to white â this is the slider that now actually whitens instead of clamping to red.

coreBoost.title: Core Boost
coreBoost.description: Extra multiplier applied only to the hottest region, to drive it well past white so bloom bleeds it into a glow. Raise for a fatter, brighter core.

corePower.title: Core Tightness
corePower.description: How tightly the white core hugs the part facing the camera. Higher = smaller, sharper hot spot; lower = the whole lens whitens.

coreBias.title: Heat Bias
coreBias.description: Lifts the whole surface up the ramp. 0 = only the facing spot goes white; raise it to push more of the lens toward amber/white; negative keeps more of it red.

rimHot.title: Invert (rim-hot)
rimHot.description: Off = centre (facing camera) is hottest â the tail-light look. On = edges glow instead (rim-light look).

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Below 1 the lens becomes translucent (renders in the transparent pass). Also the handle to fade the light with the scene if you need it.

targetMaterial.title: Target Material
targetMaterial.description: Drag the ONE material this light should replace. Only the mesh instances currently using it are swapped â the entity's other materials are left alone. Leave empty to take over every material on the entity.

startProgress.title: Collapse Start
startProgress.description: The chip is solid before this; the blocks begin collapsing here.

endProgress.title: Collapse End
endProgress.description: The chip is fully gone by here. Keep <= 0.57 (the SceneChip cut).

blockSize.title: Block Size (local units)
blockSize.description: Edge length of each collapsing block, in the chip's LOCAL space. Smaller = finer shatter (more, smaller blocks). Tune to the chip's local dimensions.

implosion.title: Implosion
implosion.description: How much the blocks converge toward the entity pivot as they collapse. 0 = each block just shrinks where it sits (crumble in place); 1 = everything sucks into the pivot. Assumes the pivot is near the chip centre.

scatter.title: Scatter (local units)
scatter.description: Chaotic outward drift added as the blocks collapse. 0 = none. Small values add a little explosive chaos on top of the shrink.

spin.title: Spin (turns)
spin.description: How many full turns each block tumbles through while it collapses.

stagger.title: Stagger
stagger.description: Per-block timing spread. 0 = all blocks collapse together; higher = a more organic ripple as some blocks go before others.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Overall strength of the whole vignette. Keep modest â additive corner light stacks up fast.

layerName.title: Render Layer
layerName.description: Layer the fullscreen pass draws on. Forced to sort LAST within that layer, so it sits on top of that layer's transparents.

cornerTL.title: Corner Â· Top Left
cornerTL.description: Strength of the top-left halo. 0 disables that corner entirely (and skips its shader cost).

tintA.title: Tint A (TL + BR)
tintA.description: Colour of the top-left / bottom-right diagonal pair. Two tints on opposite diagonals give the classic anamorphic cross-wash.

tintB.title: Tint B (TR + BL)
tintB.description: Colour of the top-right / bottom-left diagonal pair. Set equal to Tint A for a uniform vignette.

colorWash.title: Colour Wash
colorWash.description: How much the bright parts wash toward white. Lower = richer colour; higher = whiter/cleaner.

chroma.title: Chromatic Spread
chroma.description: Separation of the R/G/B ghosts. 0 = mono (no fringing); higher = more rainbow split.

flareSize.title: Halo Size
flareSize.description: Overall scale of each corner halo. Lower = tighter halos hugging the corners; higher = ghosts reaching further across the frame.

contrast.title: Shape Contrast
contrast.description: >1 = crisper, more defined ghost shapes; <1 = softer, hazier glow.

inset.title: Corner Inset
inset.description: Slides the four origins along their diagonals. 0 = exactly the corners; positive = pulled toward screen centre; negative = pushed OUTSIDE the frame (only the halo tails reach in â the subtlest look).

centerMask.title: Centre Protect
centerMask.description: How much the middle of the screen is shielded from the halos so the subject stays clean. 0 = ghosts roam the whole frame; 1 = light strictly at the edges/corners.

maskRadius.title: Protect Radius
maskRadius.description: Radius of the protected centre zone (0.5 â half the screen height).

maskSoftness.title: Protect Softness
maskSoftness.description: Width of the falloff between the protected centre and the glowing edges.

breatheAmount.title: Breathe Amount
breatheAmount.description: Slow per-corner intensity pulse so the vignette feels alive. 0 = static. Each corner breathes out of phase.

parallax.title: Cursor Drift (px)
parallax.description: How far the halo origins ease with the cursor â ties the vignette into the scene's mouse parallax. 0 = fixed.

smoothing.title: Drift Smoothing
smoothing.description: Easing of the cursor drift. Lower = more lag/float.

revealStart.title: Reveal At (progress)
revealStart.description: Scroll progress at which the vignette is fully in (fades in over the smoothness band before it).

revealEnd.title: Fade Out At (progress)
revealEnd.description: Scroll progress at which it starts fading out. Default 1 = never fades out (always on).

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Below 1 the fill is translucent (renders in the transparent pass over whatever is behind the plane). 1 = a solid opaque backdrop.

fadeOnScroll.title: Fade On Scroll
fadeOnScroll.description: Fade the whole fill in/out across a global scroll-progress window. Off = always at full Opacity (rely on the scene being enabled only in its segment).

fadeInStart.title: Fade Â· in start
fadeInStart.description: Progress where the fill begins fading in. Default 0.69 â just before SceneCar.

fadeInEnd.title: Fade Â· in full
fadeInEnd.description: Progress where the fill reaches full opacity.

fadeOutStart.title: Fade Â· out start
fadeOutStart.description: Progress where the fill begins fading out. Keep at 1 to hold it to the very end.

fadeOutEnd.title: Fade Â· out full
fadeOutEnd.description: Progress where the fill is fully gone.

colorTop.title: Colour Â· Top
colorTop.description: Colour at the top edge of the plane.

colorHorizon.title: Colour Â· Horizon
colorHorizon.description: Colour of the horizon LINE and its glows/bloom only â it is not part of the background gradient.

colorBottom.title: Colour Â· Bottom
colorBottom.description: Colour at the bottom edge of the plane.

horizonY.title: Horizon Y
horizonY.description: Vertical position of the horizon line (0 = bottom, 1 = top).

horizonWide.title: Horizon Wide Size
horizonWide.description: Reach of the broad, soft halo spreading out from the horizon.

strength.title: Horizon Wide Strength
strength.description: Brightness of the broad halo (pairs with Horizon Wide Size).

horizonGlow.title: Horizon Line Glow
horizonGlow.description: Brightness of the tight glow hugging the line (additive).

bloomSize.title: Bloom Size
bloomSize.description: Radius of the round bloom burst centred on the horizon (aspect-corrected â circular).

centerFadeRadius.title: Center Fade Radius
centerFadeRadius.description: How far the line + glow reach out from the screen centre before fading toward the sides (a sun-on-horizon falloff). Large = the line spans the whole width evenly.

flipVertical.title: Flip Vertical
flipVertical.description: Flip the gradient/horizon upside-down (swap Top and Bottom).

horizonLineWidth.title: Horizon Line Width
horizonLineWidth.description: Half-thickness of the CRISP horizon line (a solid line, not a band). Low = a thin, sharp line. 0 = no line.

horizonGlowSize.title: Horizon Glow Size
horizonGlowSize.description: Reach of the tight glow around the line.

bloomStrength.title: Bloom Strength
bloomStrength.description: Brightness of the central bloom burst. 0 = off.

swapAxes.title: Swap Axes
swapAxes.description: Rotate the whole gradient + horizon line 90Â°. Turn ON if the horizon runs UP the plane instead of ACROSS it (this plane's UVs are rotated vs. the aurora plane). Fixes Line Width thickening the wrong axis.

chipFadeStart.title: Chip Fade Start
chipFadeStart.description: The chip body starts disappearing from the centre outward. Solid before this.

dissolveEnd.title: Dissolve End
dissolveEnd.description: The chip is fully cleared by here. Keep <= 0.57 (the SceneChip cut).

chipFadeSoftness.title: Chip Fade Softness
chipFadeSoftness.description: Width of the soft fading band that sweeps from the centre outward (fraction of the chip half-size). Higher = a broader, gentler fade.

chipFadeReach.title: Chip Fade Reach
chipFadeReach.description: How far past the centre the fade front travels by Dissolve End, as a multiple of the chip half-size. 1 â the chip edge; slightly above guarantees the chip clears completely.

debug.title: Debug (console)
debug.description: Log build + fade state to the console.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Overall brightness of the glow. Values > 1 blow the core out to white and feed the scene bloom (LDR pipeline).

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: How far the glow reaches from the plane centre. 1 â touches the plane edges; lower = a tighter core, higher = fills past the edges.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Breathing depth. 0 = steady glow; 1 = dims all the way to black between beats. Speed is set below.

pulseSpeed.title: Pulse Speed (Hz)
pulseSpeed.description: Beats per second, used only when Pulse > 0.

softness.title: Softness
softness.description: Falloff shape from centre to edge. 1 = linear; higher = a softer, more concentrated core.

center.title: Center (U, V)
center.description: UV point the glow is brightest at. 0.5,0.5 = the mesh UV centre. Nudge this to move the hot spot without re-doing the UVs in Blender.

coreStrength.title: Core Strength
coreStrength.description: Brightness of the hot centre only. 1 = unchanged (original look). Lower tones down the white blown-out core while leaving the rest of the glow exactly as-is.

coreSize.title: Core Size
coreSize.description: How much of the inner glow counts as "core" for Core Strength (as a fraction of the falloff). Only has an effect when Core Strength < 1.

verticalFade.title: Vertical Fade
verticalFade.description: Linear fade toward the top and bottom UV edges (a straight vertical falloff, unlike the radial Softness). 0 = off; 1 = fully faded at the top/bottom edges. Left/right are untouched.

scale.title: Shape Scale
scale.description: Higher = more, smaller ripple loops. Lower = fewer, larger.

density.title: Ripple Count
density.description: How many ripple bands the field is contoured into. Keep low â a few elegant rings, not a moirÃ©.

speed.title: Drift Speed
speed.description: How fast the ripples move/morph. 0 = frozen.

waveAngle.title: Stage 2 Â· Wave Angle (deg)
waveAngle.description: Direction of the organised parallel wavefronts. 0 = horizontal bands.

stage2Start.title: Stage 2 Â· Starts (progress)
stage2Start.description: Scroll progress where the round drop ripples BEGIN organising into parallels.

stage2End.title: Stage 2 Â· Complete (progress)
stage2End.description: Scroll progress where the field is fully parallel. Reversible.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall strength of the ripples over the background.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Band thickness â how much of the plane the ripple crests fill. Lower = thinner lines.

pulse.title: Local Breathing
pulse.description: Bands thicken/thin by region over time while TOTAL on-screen coverage stays ~constant. 0 = drift/morph only.

fadeOnScroll.title: Fade On Scroll
fadeOnScroll.description: Fade the ripples down to the plain background across a global scroll-progress window.

fadeOut.title: Fade Out (vs In)
fadeOut.description: On: visible â invisible across the window. Off: invisible â visible.

edgeMargin.title: Edge Safe Margin
edgeMargin.description: Clear space kept at the plane top/bottom edges so ripples are never clipped by the boundary.

isActivated.title: Is Activated (master on/off)
isActivated.description: While OFF the wheel eases back to its authored rest pose and stops correcting.

maxAngle.title: Max Angle (deg)
maxAngle.description: Largest correction the wheel can swing, in degrees, Â± around the authored rest angle.

strength.title: Strength (responsiveness)
strength.description: How briskly the wheel eases toward each new target. Higher = snappier corrections, lower = lazier drift.

intervalMin.title: Interval Min (s)
intervalMin.description: Shortest time before a new random correction target is chosen.

intervalMax.title: Interval Max (s)
intervalMax.description: Longest time before a new random correction target is chosen.

centerBias.title: Center Bias
centerBias.description: 0 = targets are fully random within Â±Max Angle; 1 = strongly pulled back toward straight (0Â°). Keeps the wheel re-centering like a real trajectory hold.

ease.title: Ease the fade (smoothstep instead of linear)

uniformName.title: Uniform Name
uniformName.description: The float uniform the target shader multiplies its colour by. Leave as uOpacity for Glow and the project's custom shaders.

positionA.title: Position A
positionA.description: Where Colour A sits along the gradient (0 = start edge, 1 = end edge).

positionB.title: Position B
positionB.description: Where Colour B sits along the gradient (0 = start edge, 1 = end edge). Keep between A and C.

smooth.title: Smooth Blend
smooth.description: ON: eased (smoothstep) transition between the two stops. OFF: straight linear ramp.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity of the gradient over whatever is behind the plane.

positionC.title: Position C
positionC.description: Where Colour C sits along the gradient (0 = start edge, 1 = end edge).

bottomFade.title: Bottom Fade to Transparent
bottomFade.description: Fade the gradient to transparent over this fraction of its height at the bottom edge, so it dissolves into whatever is behind the plane. 0 = off.

bottomFadeFlip.title: Bottom Fade â Flip Edge
bottomFadeFlip.description: Which edge counts as the bottom. Toggle if the fade lands on the top instead.

bottomFadeTilt.title: Bottom Fade Tilt
bottomFadeTilt.description: Tilt the fade line diagonally instead of horizontal. 0 = horizontal; Â± slopes it the two ways. Tune by eye.

bottomFadeMin.title: Bottom Fade Min (edge)
bottomFadeMin.description: Guarantees at least this much fade right at the bottom edge (fraction of height), so a heavy Tilt never leaves a hard plane edge on the steep side. 0 = off. Keep it smaller than Bottom Fade to Transparent.

topFade.title: Top Fade to Transparent
topFade.description: Fade the gradient to transparent over this fraction of its height at the TOP edge (the opposite edge to the bottom fade). 0 = off. Combine with Bottom Fade to fade both ends.

topFadeTilt.title: Top Fade Tilt
topFadeTilt.description: Tilt the top fade line diagonally instead of horizontal. 0 = horizontal; Â± slopes it the two ways. Tune by eye.

topFadeMin.title: Top Fade Min (edge)
topFadeMin.description: Guarantees at least this much fade right at the top edge (fraction of height), so a heavy Tilt never leaves a hard plane edge on the steep side. 0 = off. Keep it smaller than Top Fade to Transparent.

colorB.title: Cloud Colour (dark)
colorB.description: Slate/shadow tone patched into the deck for contrast.

shadeAmount.title: Dark Patch Amount
shadeAmount.description: How strongly the dark tone mixes in. 0 = single-colour clouds.

shadeScale.title: Dark Patch Scale
shadeScale.description: Size of the dark patches relative to the cloud noise. Lower = broader slabs.

noiseScale.title: Noise Scale
noiseScale.description: Cloud feature size. Higher = smaller, busier puffs. Use a larger value on the NEAR parallax plane.

wind.title: Wind (UV/s)
wind.description: Drift direction/speed of the deck. Give the near plane a faster wind for parallax.

timeScale.title: Time Scale
timeScale.description: Master speed of the drift/billowing. 0 = frozen.

coverBottom.title: Coverage Bottom
coverBottom.description: Cloud amount at the BOTTOM of the plane (near Earth). 1 = solid deck.

coverTop.title: Coverage Top
coverTop.description: Cloud amount at the TOP of the plane (space). 0 = clear.

softness.title: Cloud Softness
softness.description: Width of the densityâalpha ramp. Low = hard-edged puffs; high = misty.

flipGradient.title: Flip Gradient
flipGradient.description: Toggle if the dense side lands on the wrong end of your plane.

edgeTop.title: Edge Margin Top
edgeTop.description: Alpha fades to 0 across this UV band below the top edge, so no cloud is ever clipped against space.

edgeBottom.title: Edge Margin Bottom
edgeBottom.description: 0 = the dense bottom runs to the edge (plane continues below the viewport / behind Earth).

interactEnabled.title: Cursor Disturbance
interactEnabled.description: Master toggle for the hover interaction.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to raycast the cursor onto this plane. Falls back to the first active camera.

holeRadius.title: Erode Radius
holeRadius.description: Base size of the disturbance brush (fraction of plane height). Fast strokes carve wider.

holeSoft.title: Erode Softness
holeSoft.description: How soft the brush falloff is. 0 = hard rim; 1 = fades from the very centre.

holeOrganic.title: Erode Churn
holeOrganic.description: Animated unevenness of the disturbance boundary â the smoke-like billowing of the eroded edge. 0 = clinical, smooth hole.

holeNoiseScale.title: Erode Churn Scale
holeNoiseScale.description: Frequency of the boundary churn. Lower = big slow lobes; higher = busy tendrils.

stretch.title: Horizontal Stretch
stretch.description: Flattens every cloud into a wide horizontal bank (real decks are never round blobs). 1 = isotropic puffs; higher = flatter, longer strata.

patchIsolation.title: Patch Isolation
patchIsolation.description: Breaks the deck into distinct cloud masses with clear sky between them. 0 = one continuous field; 1 = fully separated patches.

patchScale.title: Patch Scale (Ã noise scale)
patchScale.description: Size of the separate masses. Lower = few huge banks; higher = many smaller clouds.

patchGap.title: Patch Gap
patchGap.description: How much clear sky separates the patches. Higher = wider gaps, fewer clouds survive.

trailInertia.title: Erode Inertia
trailInertia.description: Momentum of the brush head. Higher = it overshoots and keeps gliding (still carving) after the mouse stops.

trailHold.title: Erode Hold (s)
trailHold.description: How long each carved spot stays fully open before the clouds start to reform.

trailDecay.title: Erode Reform (s)
trailDecay.description: How long the clouds take to heal back over a carved spot (after the Hold).

pushStrength.title: Cloud Push
pushStrength.description: How far the cloud matter is physically displaced away from the stroke (UV units). This is what makes it feel like a hand in smoke, not a mask.

swirl.title: Swirl
swirl.description: Velocity-driven curl: cloud matter rolls sideways around the stroke direction, like turbulence in the wake.

rimGlow.title: Disturbance Rim Light
rimGlow.description: Brightens the churned boundary of the disturbance so the reacting edge catches light. 0 = off.

thinning.title: Erode Thinning
thinning.description: How much the clouds go wispy AROUND the erased core (density loss before full erosion). Sells the smoke falloff.

erodeWarp.title: Trail Lookup Warp
erodeWarp.description: The disturbance field is SAMPLED through a drifting fbm-warped coordinate (the Montfort tMouse trick): the trail's silhouette goes wavy and smoky for free, and keeps re-forming over time. 0 = exact brush shape.

erodeWarpScale.title: Trail Lookup Warp Scale
erodeWarpScale.description: Frequency of the lookup warp. Lower = one big smooth deformation; higher = crinkled multi-lobed edges.

densityResist.title: Cloud Resistance
densityResist.description: The clouds resist erosion by their OWN density: wisps vanish first, thick cores hold on â so the hole follows the cloud structure instead of stamping a shape over it. The single biggest "it reacts" control.

idleFade.title: Idle Fade (s)
idleFade.description: The disturbance is born from MOTION. When the cursor rests, the brush dies over this time and the clouds slowly reveal back (the field behind heals per Hold/Reform).

trailRes.title: Trail Texture Size
trailRes.description: Resolution of the ping-pong disturbance field. 256 is plenty for smoke; read at scene load (not live).

trailDiffuse.title: Trail Spread
trailDiffuse.description: Per-frame diffusion of the carved field: the disturbance blurs outward over time like settling smoke. 0 = the stroke keeps its exact shape.

followLag.title: Follow Lag
followLag.description: How far the disturbance TRAILS BEHIND the cursor. 0 = pinned right under the mouse (stiff chase); higher = the smoke reacts late and drags behind the stroke like heavy vapour.

dispAmount.title: Displacement Amount
dispAmount.description: Vertical UV displacement at full mask (fraction of screen). Negative pulls the frame the other way.

dispRepeat.title: Displacement Scale
dispRepeat.description: Spatial frequency of the displacement field (uDispRepeat in the original).

shiftSpeed.title: Field Shift Speed
shiftSpeed.description: How fast the displacement field cycles (uShiftSpeed â the sin(rÂ·2Ï + tÂ·speed) evolution).

pulseAmount.title: Field Pulse
pulseAmount.description: Breathing of the field scale over time (uPulseAmount).

maxDistort.title: Max Chroma Distort
maxDistort.description: Barrel-distortion strength of the spectral smear (uMaxDistort).

distortRange.title: Chroma Edge Range
distortRange.description: smoothstep(x, y, |screen pos|) edge weighting â the smear is strongest at the frame edges, calm at the centre (uDistortRange).

noiseRepeat.title: Chroma Noise Scale
noiseRepeat.description: Spatial frequency of the noise that breaks up the chroma mask (uNoiseRepeat).

dipStrength.title: Dip Strength
dipStrength.description: How much the sweep region dips toward the dip colour at the peak. 0 = pure warp, no darkening.

shape.title: Wipe Shape
shape.description: Shape of the growing falloff mask â falloffDiamond / falloffSquare / falloffCircle from the original.

mosaicStrength.title: Mosaic Â· Strength
mosaicStrength.description: 0 = no tiles (pure warp, the previous look). 1 = full animated tile mosaic inside the sweep.

mosaicCells.title: Mosaic Â· Tiles Across
mosaicCells.description: How many square tiles fit across the screen width. Tiles are always square (aspect-corrected).

mosaicJitter.title: Mosaic Â· Tile Jitter
mosaicJitter.description: How far a popped tile displaces the image it samples, in tile widths â the "tiles breaking loose" offset.

mosaicFlicker.title: Mosaic Â· Flicker Speed
mosaicFlicker.description: How fast individual tiles cycle in/out while the sweep passes over them.

mosaicLine.title: Mosaic Â· Edge Thickness
mosaicLine.description: Thickness of the glowing tile borders (fraction of a tile). 0 = no borders.

mosaicLineColor.title: Mosaic Â· Edge Colour
mosaicLineColor.description: Colour of the tile borders (uEdgeColor in the cube material). White reads as bloom in the LDR pipeline.

playDuration.title: Play Duration (s)
playDuration.description: Length of a manual (chromatic:play) run, in SECONDS. The event can override it per-trigger with { duration }.

mosaicRound.title: Mosaic Â· Corner Rounding
mosaicRound.description: 0 = sharp square tiles, 1 = fully round (circular) tiles. The rounded outline is per-tile with a gutter, so it never reads as a continuous grid.

mosaicBend.title: Mosaic Â· Lattice Bend
mosaicBend.description: Low-frequency warp of the tile lattice (in tile widths). Curves the rows/columns so the tiling never looks like a straight pixel grid. 0 = rigid grid.

mosaicDrift.title: Mosaic Â· Tile Drift
mosaicDrift.description: How far each tile slowly floats around inside its cell (fraction of a tile). Gives the tiles an alive, non-locked feel.

cloudCount.title: Cloud Count
cloudCount.description: How many individual cloud shadows drift over the map (max 12).

cloudSize.title: Cloud Size
cloudSize.description: Base shadow radius as a fraction of the plane. Each cloud varies around this (see Size Variation).

sizeVariation.title: Size Variation
sizeVariation.description: Per-cloud random size spread. 0 = all clouds equal; 1 = from half to double the base size.

stretch.title: Wind Stretch
stretch.description: Elongates every shadow along the wind direction (real cloud shadows are never round). 1 = circular.

direction.title: Wind Direction (UV)
direction.description: Travel direction in plane UV space. (1, 1) = bottom-left â top-right. Normalized in the shader.

speed.title: Wind Speed (UV/s)
speed.description: Base drift speed. A cloud crosses the whole map in 1/speed seconds.

speedVariation.title: Speed Variation
speedVariation.description: Per-cloud random speed spread so the formation loosens over time instead of moving as one rigid sheet.

timeScale.title: Time Scale
timeScale.description: Master speed multiplier (drift + silhouette billowing). 0 = frozen.

shadowColor.title: Shadow Colour
shadowColor.description: Usually black. A deep blue can read as atmospheric scattering.

intensity.title: Shadow Intensity
intensity.description: Peak darkness at a shadow core. Keep subtle (0.25â0.45) â real cloud shadows are soft.

softness.title: Edge Softness
softness.description: Width of the shadow's penumbra. Low = hard-edged; high = misty falloff.

raggedness.title: Silhouette Raggedness
raggedness.description: How much drifting noise eats the shadow edge â the organic, cloud-like outline. 0 = clean ellipse.

raggedScale.title: Raggedness Scale
raggedScale.description: Frequency of the edge noise. Lower = big slow lobes; higher = busy cauliflower edges.

innerTexture.title: Inner Unevenness
innerTexture.description: Density variation INSIDE the shadow so it isn't a flat grey stamp. 0 = uniform.

sizeMode.title: Size Mode
sizeMode.description: Responsive = the size below is a FRACTION of the RT viewport height (0.089 â 96px on a 1080p RT; scales with the screen like the cards do). Fixed = world units.

textSize.title: Text Size
textSize.description: Responsive: sized to track the CARD height, calibrated so this reads as a fraction of viewport height on a 16:9 desktop (0.089 â 96px on a 1080p RT) and scales with the card on every other aspect. Fixed: world units.

maxWidthFraction.title: Max Width (fraction of viewport)
maxWidthFraction.description: Responsive mode only: each word shrinks so it never exceeds this fraction of the viewport WIDTH ("INTELLIGENCE" is long â this stops it overflowing on narrow/mobile screens). 1 = no clamp.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity (the UICamera)
cameraEntity.description: The UICamera that captures the deck into the render target (the entity carrying screenRenderTarget.js). The text is parented to it and drawn into the same RT.

offsetY1.title: Offset Y 1 (+ = up)
offsetY1.description: Vertical offset of Text 1 from the centre, BEFORE the animation travel. Responsive: fraction of the CARD height (calibrated to viewport height on a 16:9 desktop), so it stays locked to the card on every aspect. Fixed: world units.

offsetY2.title: Offset Y 2 (+ = up)
offsetY2.description: Vertical offset of Text 2 from the centre, BEFORE the animation travel. Responsive: fraction of the CARD height (calibrated to viewport height on a 16:9 desktop), so it stays locked to the card on every aspect. Fixed: world units.

distance.title: Distance from UICamera (manual â Auto Depth OFF)
distance.description: Used only when Auto Depth is off (or no CardSystem is found). Camera-space depth of the text; set it LARGER than the deck's distance so the cards sort in front. In Responsive mode this does NOT change the apparent size.

travelUp.title: Travel Up â Text 1
travelUp.description: How far Text 1 rises across the split band. Responsive: fraction of the CARD height (calibrated to viewport height on a 16:9 desktop). Fixed: world units.

travelDown.title: Travel Down â Text 2
travelDown.description: How far Text 2 sinks across the split band. Responsive: fraction of the CARD height (calibrated to viewport height on a 16:9 desktop). Fixed: world units.

animSmoothing.title: Animation Smoothing
animSmoothing.description: Per-frame easing of the split motion on top of the scroll. Lower = floatier / more lag, 1 = locked to the scroll.

fadeBlur.title: Fade Blur (max)
fadeBlur.description: Blur at the transparent end of the fade â the text animates sharp+opaque â blurred+transparent (focus-pull). 0 = plain opacity fade.

autoDepth.title: Auto Depth (sit just behind the deck)
autoDepth.description: ON = read CardSystem for the deck's distance from the UICamera and place the text just behind it (by Depth Margin), so the transparent sort always draws the cards over the text. OFF = use the manual Distance below.

depthMargin.title: Depth Margin (world units behind the deck)
depthMargin.description: Auto Depth only: how far behind the deck plane the text sits. Just needs to be enough that the text reliably sorts behind the cards; it does NOT change the apparent size (responsive).

followCard.title: Follow Card (track its horizontal motion)
followCard.description: Optional: the card #0 entity (the one carrying cardZeroFollow.js). When set, the text tracks card #0 horizontally so it stays locked behind the card as the deck slides â the split reveal then happens relative to the card, not a fixed screen centre. Screen X above is then a relative nudge on top. Leave empty to stay screen-anchored.

mobileBreakpoint.title: Mobile Â· Breakpoint (px)
mobileBreakpoint.description: Viewport width at/below which Mobile Â· Text Size replaces Text Size.

textSizeMobile.title: Mobile Â· Text Size
textSizeMobile.description: Text Size used at/below the breakpoint. Larger than Text Size makes the words bigger on mobile (the Max Width clamp still stops overflow).

fadeSpace.title: Fade Source
fadeSpace.description: World = fade the mesh's bounding-box footprint (no UVs needed, best default). UV = fade near the UV border (only if the mesh has a tidy 0..1 UV).

upAxis.title: Up Axis (World mode)
upAxis.description: Which world axis is the map's "up". The fade is measured in the OTHER two axes (the footprint). Y-up = a map lying flat in the X-Z plane, like terrain.

edgeFade.title: Edge Fade (border width)
edgeFade.description: Fraction of the map (from the edge inward) over which it fades to transparent. 0.3 = the outer 30% dissolves; small = only a thin rim; 1 = fades all the way from the centre.

roundness.title: Roundness
roundness.description: 0 = a rectangular border fade (uniform width on all four sides). 1 = a radial/elliptical falloff that also rounds the corners away. In between blends the two.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall opacity of the map (the uOpacity sink). Drop shaderFade.js on this entity to drive it from scroll instead.

writeDepth.title: Write Depth
writeDepth.description: ON = the map writes the depth buffer, so objects placed INSIDE its 3D relief (e.g. the infraGrid plane above the land but below the peaks) are correctly occluded by the terrain. OFF = the transparent rim never occludes anything behind it â use only if the faded edge clips/halos other transparent objects.

startAngle.title: Start Angle (local Â°)
startAngle.description: Local euler rotation applied at (and below) Start Progress.

endAngle.title: End Angle (local Â°)
endAngle.description: Local euler rotation reached at (and above) End Progress.

smooth.title: Ease ends (smoothstep)
smooth.description: OFF = linear tracking (1:1 with scroll). ON = eased in/out at the range ends so the tilt starts and settles softly.

density.title: Block Density
density.description: How many city blocks fit across the map footprint height.

jitter.title: Street Irregularity
jitter.description: How far minor streets wander off the perfect grid. Avenues stay much straighter.

lineWidth.title: Line Width
lineWidth.description: Thickness of the hot core of a minor street, in block units.

haloScale.title: Glow Softness
haloScale.description: How far the soft halo spreads beyond the core (Ã line width).

breakFreq.title: Break Frequency
breakFreq.description: How often a minor street is chopped into segments. Avenues never break.

breakAmount.title: Broken Segments
breakAmount.description: Fraction of minor street segments that are missing. 0 = solid streets.

avenueEvery.title: Avenue Spacing
avenueEvery.description: Every Nth line is a major avenue: straighter, wider, brighter, unbroken.

avenueWidth.title: Avenue Width
avenueWidth.description: How much wider major avenues are than minor streets.

avenueBright.title: Avenue Brightness
avenueBright.description: How much brighter major avenues are than minor streets.

nodeSize.title: Node Size
nodeSize.description: Radius of the glowing intersection nodes (block units).

nodeDensity.title: Node Density
nodeDensity.description: Fraction of intersections that grow a node.

secondary.title: Secondary Links
secondary.description: Strength of the faint diagonals that flash at the wavefront. 0 = off.

coverScale.title: District Scale
coverScale.description: Size of the developed districts. Lower = larger sprawling districts.

coverThreshold.title: District Coverage
coverThreshold.description: How much of the map is built up. Higher = more empty land.

edgeFeather.title: Edge Feather
edgeFeather.description: Safety fade toward the footprint border.

landLevel.title: Land Level (0=lowest, 1=peak)
landLevel.description: Normalised terrain elevation below which the grid shows. The grid lights the flat land and disappears on anything higher â mountains stay clean.

landFade.title: Land Fade
landFade.description: Elevation band over which the grid fades out above Land Level, so it dies off up the slopes instead of a hard cut.

boundRadius.title: Pulse Reach
boundRadius.description: How far the pulse reaches from the centre (in footprint heights).

boundJitter.title: Reach Irregularity
boundJitter.description: How much the reach varies by direction (abstract blob, never a rectangle).

boundLobes.title: Reach Lobes
boundLobes.description: How many bulges the irregular boundary has.

boundSoft.title: Reach Softness
boundSoft.description: How softly the glow dissolves at its outer boundary.

centerEntity.title: Pulse Centre (optional)
centerEntity.description: Entity the pulse originates from â its world position is dropped straight down (map-local) onto the footprint. If it hovers far above the terrain prefer the Manual Centre U/V below.

centerU.title: Manual Centre U
centerU.description: Pulse origin across the map footprint (0..1) when no Pulse Centre entity is assigned.

centerV.title: Manual Centre V
centerV.description: Pulse origin up the map footprint (0..1) when no Pulse Centre entity is assigned.

pulseSpeed.title: Launch Speed
pulseSpeed.description: Initial expansion speed of the wavefront (footprint-heights/s), decelerating outward.

easeOut.title: Deceleration
easeOut.description: 1 = constant speed; higher = hard launch that exhausts at the edge.

frontJitter.title: Wavefront Raggedness
frontJitter.description: Uneven front â districts light up at different times. 0 = perfect ring.

frontScale.title: Raggedness Scale
frontScale.description: Lobe size of the ragged front. Lower = big sweeping lobes.

frontSoftness.title: Front Softness
frontSoftness.description: Width of the switch-on band at the wavefront.

attack.title: Node Delay
attack.description: Seconds after the front passes before a node reaches full flare.

trail.title: Fade Trail
trail.description: How long the glow lingers behind the wavefront (seconds).

crestWidth.title: Crest Width
crestWidth.description: Width of the bright leading edge.

edgeBoost.title: Crest Brightness
edgeBoost.description: Extra brightness of the leading crest, scaled by the front's current speed.

impactStrength.title: Impact Flash
impactStrength.description: Hot bloom at the origin the instant a pulse is born. 0 = off.

impactTime.title: Impact Decay (s)
impactTime.description: How fast the impact flash burns off.

colorSpeed.title: Colour Flow Speed
colorSpeed.description: How fast the amber/gold variation travels along the streets.

upAxis.title: Up Axis (map local)
upAxis.description: The map's LOCAL up axis (should match mapblend's). The footprint is the other two axes; elevation is measured along this one.

triggerProgress.title: Trigger at Scroll Progress
triggerProgress.description: Scroll progress at which the pulse fires. Scrolling back re-arms.

triggerEvent.title: Trigger Event
triggerEvent.description: EventBus event that also fires a pulse. Empty = disabled.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Keep re-firing pulses on a timer while past the scroll trigger.

debug.title: Debug Centre
debug.description: Log the computed pulse-centre UV each time a pulse fires.

cloudPlane.title: Cloud Plane
cloudPlane.description: Plane hovering above the terrain, child of the rotating map group. Material is replaced by the cloud shader. Leave empty for shadows only.

upAxis.title: Up Axis (map local)
upAxis.description: The map's LOCAL up axis (match mapblend/infraGridMap). The cloud/shadow field lives on the other two axes.

noiseScale.title: Cloud Scale
noiseScale.description: Noise tiles across the map footprint. Lower = fewer, bigger cloud masses.

coverage.title: Coverage Threshold
coverage.description: Noise level below which a cloud exists (primland: 0.25). Higher = more sky covered.

softness.title: Edge Softness
softness.description: Width of the threshold window (primland: 0.25â0.37). Narrow = crisp cut-outs; wide = misty.

windDir.title: Wind Direction (map local)
windDir.description: Drift direction on the map footprint. Rotates with the group. Normalized internally.

windSpeed.title: Wind Speed
windSpeed.description: Base drift speed (primland: 0.040). Each layer runs at a slightly different multiple, so shapes recompose without visible repetition.

timeScale.title: Time Scale
timeScale.description: Master clock multiplier (drift + interior billowing). 0 = frozen.

shadowIntensity.title: Shadow Intensity
shadowIntensity.description: Peak darkening. Even at 1 the primland clamp keeps ~25% luminosity â never black blotches.

sunOffset.title: Sun Offset (footprint UV)
sunOffset.description: How far each shadow is displaced from the cloud above it (fraction of the map). Sells the altitude.

cloudOpacity.title: Cloud Opacity
cloudOpacity.description: Peak alpha at a cloud core.

innerDetail.title: Inner Billowing
innerDetail.description: customFog ondulation inside the bodies: two sheets scrolling in opposite directions, mixed by each other. 0 = flat stamps.

detailScale.title: Billowing Scale
detailScale.description: Frequency of the interior detail relative to the cloud field.

detailSpeed.title: Billowing Speed
detailSpeed.description: Counter-scroll speed of the two interior sheets.

falloffStart.title: Falloff Start
falloffStart.description: Radial distance (1 = footprint edge) where clouds start fading, so they dissolve before the map's own rim.

falloffEnd.title: Falloff End
falloffEnd.description: Radial distance where clouds are fully gone.

viewMode.title: View Mode (test)
viewMode.description: Isolate one half for tuning. Shadows only hides the cloud plane; Clouds only mutes the terrain darkening. Both = final look.

clearRadius.title: Centre Clear Radius
clearRadius.description: Radial distance (1 = footprint edge) out to which clouds fade away over the map centre, so it stays readable. 0 = disabled.

clearFade.title: Centre Clear Intensity
clearFade.description: How strongly the centre is cleared. 1 = fully clear at the middle, fading to full clouds at the radius; 0 = no effect. Clouds only.

interactEnabled.title: Cursor Disturbance
interactEnabled.description: Master toggle for the hover interaction on the cloud plane.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to raycast the cursor onto the cloud plane. Falls back to the first active camera.

trailRes.title: Trail Texture Size
trailRes.description: Resolution of the ping-pong disturbance field. 256 is plenty; read at scene load (not live).

trailDiffuse.title: Trail Spread
trailDiffuse.description: Per-frame diffusion of the carved field â the disturbance blurs outward like settling smoke. 0 = keeps its exact shape.

holeRadius.title: Erode Radius
holeRadius.description: Base size of the disturbance brush (fraction of the footprint). Fast strokes carve wider.

holeSoft.title: Erode Softness
holeSoft.description: Brush falloff. 0 = hard rim; 1 = fades from the very centre.

holeOrganic.title: Erode Churn
holeOrganic.description: Animated unevenness of the disturbance boundary â the smoke-like billowing of the eroded edge. 0 = clinical hole.

holeNoiseScale.title: Erode Churn Scale
holeNoiseScale.description: Frequency of the boundary churn. Lower = big slow lobes; higher = busy tendrils.

erodeWarp.title: Trail Lookup Warp
erodeWarp.description: The field is SAMPLED through a drifting fbm-warped coordinate (Montfort tMouse): the silhouette goes wavy/smoky for free and keeps re-forming. 0 = exact brush shape.

erodeWarpScale.title: Trail Lookup Warp Scale
erodeWarpScale.description: Frequency of the lookup warp. Lower = one big smooth deformation; higher = crinkled multi-lobed edges.

densityResist.title: Cloud Resistance
densityResist.description: Clouds resist erosion by their OWN density: wisps vanish first, thick cores hold â the hole follows the cloud structure instead of stamping a shape.

idleFade.title: Idle Fade (s)
idleFade.description: The disturbance is born from MOTION. When the cursor rests, the brush dies over this time and clouds slowly reveal back.

followLag.title: Follow Lag
followLag.description: How far the disturbance TRAILS BEHIND the cursor. 0 = pinned under the mouse; higher = drags behind like heavy vapour.

trailInertia.title: Erode Inertia
trailInertia.description: Momentum of the brush head. Higher = it overshoots and keeps gliding (still carving) after the mouse stops.

trailHold.title: Erode Hold (s)
trailHold.description: How long each carved spot stays fully open before clouds start to reform.

trailDecay.title: Erode Reform (s)
trailDecay.description: How long clouds take to heal back over a carved spot (after the Hold).

pushStrength.title: Cloud Push
pushStrength.description: How far cloud matter is physically displaced away from the stroke (UV units). This is what makes it feel like a hand in smoke, not a mask.

swirl.title: Swirl
swirl.description: Velocity-driven curl: cloud matter rolls sideways around the stroke direction, like turbulence in the wake.

rimGlow.title: Disturbance Rim Light
rimGlow.description: Brightens the churned boundary of the disturbance so the reacting edge catches light. 0 = off.

thinning.title: Erode Thinning
thinning.description: How much clouds go wispy AROUND the erased core (density loss before full erosion). Sells the smoke falloff.

revealStart.title: Reveal Start (progress)
revealStart.description: Below this scroll progress the cloud plane + trail sim are OFF (no cost) and clouds/shadows are invisible.

revealEnd.title: Reveal End (progress)
revealEnd.description: Clouds + shadows fade in from Reveal Start to here, then stay on. Equal to Reveal Start = hard cut.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Overall strength of the effect (fades the whole distortion).

normalStrength.title: Ripple Steepness
normalStrength.description: Amplifies the wave slope before it offsets the background â the fine ripple detail.

interactEnabled.title: Cursor Ripple
interactEnabled.description: Master toggle for the mouse interaction (the sim still runs, ripples just stop being fed).

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to raycast the cursor onto this plane. Falls back to the first active camera.

simRes.title: Sim Resolution
simRes.description: Resolution of the ripple field. Higher = finer, longer-reaching ripples (costlier). Read at scene load, not live.

distortion.title: Distortion
distortion.description: How far the ripples push the background sample, in screen fractions. The main strength knob.

maskGain.title: Reveal Gain
maskGain.description: How readily a ripple becomes visible. Still water is transparent; this sets how little wave energy it takes to show the distortion.

tint.title: Tint
tint.description: Multiplies the refracted background. White = no colour (pure clear distortion).

chromatic.title: Chromatic
chromatic.description: Splits R/G/B across the offset for a subtle glassy rainbow fringe on the ripple edges. 0 = clean.

brushSize.title: Trail Size
brushSize.description: Width of the patch dropped under the cursor (fraction of the view). Bigger = a fatter blob of fluid.

trailDecay.title: Trail Persistence
trailDecay.description: How long the patch lingers before fading. Lower = fades away quickly behind the cursor; toward 1 = a long-lived smear. (Noomo trailDecay â 0.995.)

spread.title: Softening
spread.description: How much the patch diffuses/blurs outward each frame â keeps it one cohesive shape instead of a hard stamp. (Noomo 10.5 texels.)

followLag.title: Mouse Lag
followLag.description: How far the patch TRAILS BEHIND the cursor. 0 = pinned right under the mouse; higher = it reacts late and drags behind the stroke like something heavy.

inertia.title: Inertia
inertia.description: Momentum of the patch. Higher = it overshoots and keeps gliding (still drawing) after the mouse stops, then coasts to rest.

speedThreshold.title: Speed Threshold
speedThreshold.description: How fast the cursor must move before the ripple shows. LOWER = even slow movements trigger the distortion; higher = only quick flicks do. This is the per-frame stamp travel (view fractions) at which the stroke reaches full strength â it also sets how quickly the trail fades once you stop.

activeStart.title: Active From
activeStart.description: Scroll progress where the effect wakes (grab + sim resume). Set a little BEFORE any shaderFade fade-in so the grab is already warm when it becomes visible. 0 with Active To 1 = always on (old behaviour).

activeEnd.title: Active To
activeEnd.description: Scroll progress where the effect shuts off again and the scene-colour grab is released.

startProgress.title: Start Progress
startProgress.description: Global scroll progress where the bands begin sliding in (local t = 0).

endProgress.title: End Progress
endProgress.description: Global scroll progress where the outro is fully resolved (local t = 1).

dimAmount.title: Background Dim
dimAmount.description: Peak opacity of the black layer over SceneCar behind the letterbox gap (0.5 = the scene reads at half brightness).

finalAt.title: Finale Fade-In at (t)
finalAt.description: The logo + tagline + e-mail fade in here.

fadeWidth.title: Fade Width (t)
fadeWidth.description: How much local progress each fade in / fade out ramp spans.

bandsCloseAt.title: Bands Closed at (t)
bandsCloseAt.description: Local t where the bands reach a FULL black screen. They grow linearly from t=0 to here (always moving with the scroll). Keep it just below Finale at so the logo lands on solid black.

line1OutAt.title: Line 1 Fade-Out at (t)
line1OutAt.description: "Edolus never existed." starts fading OUT here (done a Fade Width later).

line2OutAt.title: Line 2 Fade-Out at (t)
line2OutAt.description: "The experience did." starts fading OUT here (done a Fade Width later).

logoGap.title: Logo â Tagline Gap (px)
logoGap.description: Desktop vertical space between the logo and the tagline. Scales down on mobile (clamp) to ~35% on phones (â65% smaller) so the layout tightens.

emailGap.title: Tagline â E-mail Gap (px)
emailGap.description: Desktop vertical space between the tagline and the e-mail. Scales down on mobile (clamp) to ~35% on phones (â65% smaller) so the layout tightens.

emailSize.title: E-mail Font Size (px)
emailSize.description: Desktop font size of the [ STUDIO@VERTEX3D.ASIA ] line. It is the MAX of a responsive clamp â below ~500px viewport it scales down (floored ~65%) so it isn't oversized on phones.

blurIntensity.title: Blur Intensity (px)
blurIntensity.description: Peak backdrop blur applied to the scene behind the bands. Reached at Blur Max Progress.

blurMaxProgress.title: Blur Max at (progress)
blurMaxProgress.description: Global scroll progress where the blur hits full Blur Intensity. It ramps up (eased) from Start Progress (0px) to here.

replayBottomGap.title: Replay Button Bottom Margin (px)
replayBottomGap.description: Distance from the bottom of the screen to the REPLAY EXPERIENCE button (text + underline). It fades in with the finale.

replayFadeMs.title: Replay: Fade-to-Black (ms)
replayFadeMs.description: How long the screen fades to full black when REPLAY EXPERIENCE is clicked, before the logo draws in.

replayHoldMs.title: Replay: Hold before bands open (ms)
replayHoldMs.description: Pause on the finished centred logo (~300â500 ms) before the black bands start opening.

tint.title: Tint
tint.description: Colour multiplier on the flare. Leave white to keep the image colours; push red/orange for tail lights.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Brightness of the glow. Emissive clamps at 1.0 in the LDR pipeline, so values above 1 mainly bloom out the brightest core.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Full/target opacity of the flare. The fade-in/out animates a 0â1 multiplier ON TOP of this, so this stays the brightness the flare fades UP to.

blendMode.title: Blend Mode
blendMode.description: Screen: brightens what is behind and white always shows (best when a white flare "disappeared" in additive). Additive: hotter glow that adds light and can clip to white. Normal: plain alpha blend.

flipX.title: Flip Horizontally
flipX.description: Mirror the image left-to-right, so the same flare texture can drive both the left and right rear light.

autoFadeIn.title: Auto Fade In
autoFadeIn.description: Fade the flare in from 0 automatically when it first appears (on start).

scrollDriven.title: Fade With Scroll
scrollDriven.description: Drive the fade from scroll progress instead of the one-shot Auto Fade In.

fadeInEnd.title: Scroll Â· Fade-In End
fadeInEnd.description: Fully faded in after this scroll progress.

fadeOutStart.title: Scroll Â· Fade-Out Start
fadeOutStart.description: Starts fading out here. Keep Start & End at 1 to never fade out.

fadeOutEnd.title: Scroll Â· Fade-Out End
fadeOutEnd.description: Fully gone after this scroll progress.

gradientPosition.title: Gradient Position (0 = bottom, 1 = top)
gradientPosition.description: Where the middle of the fade sits along the pods' height. Measured against the object's auto-detected world-space vertical bounds.

smoothness.title: Smoothness (softness of the transition)
smoothness.description: Height of the soft band, as a fraction of the object's total height. 0 = a hard cut line; 1 = spread across the whole object.

fadeTop.title: Invert (fade the TOP instead of the bottom)

minOpacity.title: Min Opacity (how faded the faded end gets)
minOpacity.description: 0 = the faded end vanishes completely; raise it to leave the bottom as a faint ghost instead of fully gone.

autoBounds.title: Auto bounds (measure the pods' height automatically)

worldMinY.title: Manual Bottom Y (world)  â used when Auto bounds is off

worldMaxY.title: Manual Top Y (world)  â used when Auto bounds is off

keepShadows.title: Keep casting shadows (may not compile if pods cast shadows)

targetMaterial.title: Target Material
targetMaterial.description: Only the mesh instances using this material are faded. Leave empty to fade every material on the entity.

doubleSided.title: Double Sided (fade & light both face directions)
doubleSided.description: On = every face fades and is lit correctly (fixes black interior faces once the pod turns transparent). Off = only outward faces render.

imageAsset.title: Image
imageAsset.description: The texture to display on the plane. Its alpha is ignored (fully opaque).

tint.title: Tint
tint.description: Colour multiplier on the image. Leave white to keep the original colours.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Multiplier on the image. In the unlit (emissive) mode this clamps at 1.0 in the LDR pipeline; above 1 mainly blooms the brightest pixels.

lit.title: Lit
lit.description: Off (default): unlit â the image shows its true colours, ignoring lighting. On: the plane is a normal diffuse surface that reacts to scene lights.

doubleSided.title: Double Sided
doubleSided.description: Show the image on both faces of the plane (no back-face culling).

size.title: Size (world units)
size.description: Height of the text block in world units; the plane is rescaled to match (width follows the text aspect).

blurStrength.title: Blur Strength
blurStrength.description: Max blur (mip levels) of the reveal, and the dissolve threshold: wherever hover blur exceeds this, the text fades out.

hoverBlur.title: Hover Blur
hoverBlur.description: Extra blur added at the cursor. 0 disables the hover effect.

hoverRadius.title: Hover Radius
hoverRadius.description: Reach of the cursor influence, in screen-height units (0.5 = the reference).

hoverEase.title: Hover Ease (per second)
hoverEase.description: How fast the blur spot chases the cursor. 0 = locked to it.

revealProgress.title: Reveal Progress
revealProgress.description: 0 = fully blurred/dissolved, 1 = sharp. Animate for the initial appearance.

bakePx.title: Bake Font Size (px)
bakePx.description: Canvas pixels per em when baking the texture. Higher = crisper up close.

padding.title: Padding (em)
padding.description: Transparent margin baked around the text so the blur has room and never clips at the plane edge.

flipY.title: Flip Vertically
flipY.description: Tick if the text shows upside-down for your plane orientation.

minOpacity.title: Min Opacity
minOpacity.description: Floor of the dissolve: where the effect would fully erase the text (under the cursor / at Reveal 0), it stops here instead. 0 = disappears completely (original), 1 = never dissolves (blur only).

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Position of the wave: 0 = below the screen (off), 1 = past the top (off). Ignored while Drive by Scroll is on.

slope.title: Cut Slope
slope.description: Linear: diagonal tilt of the sweep line (0 = straight). Radial: raggedness of the ring. The reference used 0.2.

parallax.title: Parallax
parallax.description: How far the not-yet-swept side slides (screen fractions) while the wave passes. 0 = site rock-steady, only the band distorts.

displacement.title: Slab Displacement
displacement.description: Vertical shear of the noise "tech slabs" near the cut edge.

aberration.title: Chromatic Aberration
aberration.description: Strength of the rainbow barrel-smear near the cut (fades toward the screen edges, like the reference's modulator).

cutNoise.title: Cut Noise (optional override)
cutNoise.description: Replaces the generated noise. R = ragged cut mask, G = tech slabs, B = slope warp â the igloo tScroll layout.

demo.title: Demo Sweep
demo.description: Ping-pongs the wave automatically so you can preview it without scrolling.

scrollDriven.title: Scroll Â· Drive by Scroll
scrollDriven.description: The wave front tracks the global scroll progress linearly across the window below (overrides Progress; Demo Sweep overrides both).

noiseScale.title: Cut Noise Scale
noiseScale.description: Tiling of the noise pattern on screen. Above 1 = the texture repeats more (smaller features); below 1 = zoomed in (bigger features). Applies to the built-in noise too.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Travel of the wave front. Linear modes slide the parallax along the sweep axis; radial modes turn it into a zoom from/toward the centre and the Cut Slope into ring raggedness.

appearSfxEvent.title: Appear SFX event
appearSfxEvent.description: EventBus event emitted once when this wave sweeps in (e.g. audio:quantum); companion "<event>Stop" fires when it leaves. Blank = no sound. Set on ONE instance only.

sfxEndProgress.title: Appear SFX Â· Keep until (global progress)
sfxEndProgress.description: Keep the Appear SFX playing until this GLOBAL scroll progress, PAST the wave's Window End (0 = stop with the wave). e.g. Window End 0.57 but sound until 0.61. It also delays the start on the way back so it turns on at this progress in reverse. Only used if > Window End.

pointCount.title: Point Count
pointCount.description: Number of drifting points in the cloud.

shellThickness.title: Shell Thickness
shellThickness.description: 0 = points sit ON the sphere surface (a web around an object), 1 = solid ball.

connectionDistance.title: Connection Distance
connectionDistance.description: Rest-space distance under which two points get a candidate line.

maxLinks.title: Max Links / Point
maxLinks.description: Cap on lines per point, nearest first. Keeps the web airy.

showNodes.title: Show Nodes
showNodes.description: Draw a small cross (the hudText "+") at each point.

seed.title: Layout Seed
seed.description: Deterministic scatter â change to reshuffle the cloud.

driftAmount.title: Drift Amount
driftAmount.description: How far each point wanders from its rest position (world units).

driftSpeed.title: Drift Speed
driftSpeed.description: How fast the points wander. 0 = frozen web.

linkFadeRange.title: Link Fade Range
linkFadeRange.description: Softness of the connect/disconnect: lines are fully on below Connection Distance Ã (1 â range) and gone above Ã (1 + range).

nodeSize.title: Node Size
nodeSize.description: Full span of the cross icon at each point (world units).

revealProgress.title: Reveal Progress
revealProgress.description: 0 = hidden, 1 = fully shown. Sweeps the web in along Reveal Direction â tween this from GSAP for the hover/appear animation.

revealDirection.title: Reveal Direction
revealDirection.description: Local-space direction the reveal sweeps along (bottomâtop by default).

revealMargin.title: Reveal Margin
revealMargin.description: Softness of the reveal edge (same margin semantics as the source falloffsmooth).

mouseInteraction.title: Mouse Push
mouseInteraction.description: Let the cursor shove nearby points, re-knitting the web as it passes.

mousePush.title: Push Strength
mousePush.description: How far the cursor displaces the points (world units).

mouseRadius.title: Push Radius
mouseRadius.description: How close the cursor ray must pass (world units) to affect a point.

mouseSmoothing.title: Cursor Smoothing
mouseSmoothing.description: Easing of the raw cursor before it is sampled into the wake. Lower = more lag/springiness.

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to project the cursor. Auto-detected if left empty.

fitTarget.title: Fit To (satellite)
fitTarget.description: Drop the satellite here: the cloud centers on its mesh bounds â tracked LIVE every frame, so the web follows it â and its satelliteMover drives the Arrival Fade. Radii stay the manual values above.

nodeThickness.title: Cross Thickness
nodeThickness.description: Arm thickness as a fraction of the cross size. 0.08 â the hairline hudText cross.

radiusSmall.title: Radius Â· Small
radiusSmall.description: Cloud radius while the satellite is at its in-view pose, before the scroll expansion (world units).

radiusBig.title: Radius Â· Big
radiusBig.description: Cloud radius after the scroll expansion (world units). The scatter & line pairing are built at this size.

arrivalFade.title: Fade In With Satellite
arrivalFade.description: Fade the web in as the satellite flies from its off-screen pose to its in-view pose. Read live from the satelliteMover on (or above) the Fit To entity â NOT from scroll progress, so it works while the intro gate still pins progress at 0, and resets on REPLAY.

expandStart.title: Expand Start (small before this)
expandStart.description: Global scroll progress where the small â big growth begins (same 0..1 space as shaderFade).

trailTime.title: Wake Duration (s)
trailTime.description: How long the cursor's wake lingers after it has moved on. Longer = the web keeps drifting after the cursor leaves; short = snappy.

trailSpacing.title: Wake Sample Spacing
trailSpacing.description: Minimum cursor travel (world units) before a new sample is recorded. Larger = a coarser, longer wake. 0 = record every frame.

trailFadeIn.title: Wake Fade-In (s)
trailFadeIn.description: Each wake sample ramps up to full strength over this many seconds â cures the visible "pop" when the cursor moves slowly. Too high feels laggy.

pushAlong.title: Push: Along stroke
pushAlong.description: Shoves points in the DIRECTION THE CURSOR IS TRAVELLING â the ingredient that kills the "circular blast" look. Keep it dominant.

pushSwirl.title: Push: Swirl
pushSwirl.description: Sideways curl perpendicular to the stroke, so the wake rolls instead of shoving flatly.

pushOut.title: Push: Outward
pushOut.description: The old radial away-from-cursor push, kept as a garnish so points don't pile up on the cursor line. Keep it low.

lightColor.title: Light Colour A
lightColor.description: Colour of a dormant/quiet patch of the network. Amber/gold â (1.0, 0.62, 0.26).

trailPersistence.title: Trail Persistence
trailPersistence.description: Per-frame keep of the previous reveal. Higher = the window lingers longer behind the cursor.

spotIgnite.title: Reveal Ignite
spotIgnite.description: Floor for the LIVE brush so it reveals instantly instead of waiting for the feedback to build.

trailDistortion.title: Trail Distortion
trailDistortion.description: How far the feedback re-samples through noise each frame â the smoky CRAWL of the reveal trail.

followLag.title: Mouse Lag
followLag.description: Spring softness of the reveal window chasing the cursor. 0 = pinned under the mouse.

inertia.title: Inertia
inertia.description: Momentum â higher and the window keeps gliding (still revealing) after the mouse stops.

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Camera used to raycast the cursor onto the floor. Falls back to the active camera.

simRes.title: Sim Resolution
simRes.description: Reveal-mask field resolution. Read at scene load, not live.

lift.title: Overlay Lift
lift.description: Offset of the light overlay above the floor to avoid z-fighting (same as infinityFloor). Fine steps (0.0001) â lower it if the plane still sits too high.

activeStart.title: Active From
activeStart.description: Scroll progress where the effect wakes (sim resumes). Set a little before any shaderFade fade-in.

activeEnd.title: Active To
activeEnd.description: Scroll progress where the effect shuts off (sim stops, overlay hidden).

trailBlur.title: Trail Blur (texels)
trailBlur.description: Per-frame diffusion reach of the reveal mask (matches pointerRipple's proven-soft ~10 texel spread). The main softness knob for the window's edge.

lightColor2.title: Light Colour B
lightColor2.description: Colour an AWAKE patch skews toward â a lighter gold, so activity reads with a little colour shift, not just brightness.

brushRadius.title: Brush Radius (world units)
brushRadius.description: Size (Gaussian sigma) of the soft reveal window the cursor drags â no hard edge. Purely a window onto the network below; it has no effect on the network itself.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Light energy before the light/(light+1) knee.

whiteBoost.title: White Boost
whiteBoost.description: How much the brightest filaments are pushed toward pure white. LDR pipeline can't overbright, so this fakes it in-shader.

noiseScale.title: Curve Scale
noiseScale.description: World-space frequency of the filament curves. Higher = smaller, finer curves ("very small lights"). Same value everywhere on the floor â a property of the surface, not the cursor.

noiseSpeed.title: Curve Drift Speed
noiseSpeed.description: A SMALL residual linear drift on top of the morph below, for a little extra flow character. Keep this low (or 0) â it's a straight scroll, and the Morph settings are what should carry most of the motion so the curves visibly bend and reshape instead of just sliding.

ridgeSharpness.title: Curve Sharpness
ridgeSharpness.description: How thin the light curves are. Cartier's original is a hairline 20. Lower = softer, broader curves.

patternBase.title: Base Glow
patternBase.description: Faint ambient brightness between the curves, so awake patches aren't pitch black off-filament.

activityScale.title: Patch Scale
activityScale.description: World-space frequency of the awake/dormant PATCHES (much lower than Curve Scale â these are broad regions, not individual curves). Lower = bigger, easier-to-perceive whole-shape merges.

activitySpeed.title: Patch Drift Speed
activitySpeed.description: How fast the awake/dormant boundary drifts â this is the actual engine of "merge / expand / contract / fade": two noise layers moving at slightly different rates so the boundary between them never sits still. This is usually the MAIN thing you feel as "the lights moving" â lower it first if everything feels too fast; raise it if the merging/fading is too subtle to notice.

activityContrast.title: Patch Softness
activityContrast.description: Width of the fade between awake and dormant. Lower = sharper patch edges; higher = very soft, slow fades in/out â the "fade away" part should be clearly visible as a process, not a flip.

morphAmount.title: Morph Amount (world units)
morphAmount.description: How far the curve pattern's own sampling coordinate is warped by a slow-evolving noise field. THIS is what makes curves bend, split and merge over time instead of sliding sideways â the main fix for "it's just scrolling." 0 = pure scroll (Curve Drift Speed only).

morphScale.title: Morph Scale
morphScale.description: World-space frequency of the warp field. Lower = broad, slow-rolling bends; higher = busier, more local warping.

morphSpeed.title: Morph Speed
morphSpeed.description: How fast the warp field itself evolves â the pace at which curves visibly reshape.

maxStretch.title: Max Stretch (Ã Brush Radius)
maxStretch.description: Hard cap on how far a single frame's trail stamp can stretch behind the cursor, as a multiple of Brush Radius. Lower this if the reveal ever looks like an elongated streak/band instead of a compact radius (e.g. from fast cursor moves, or a big floor where small screen moves cover a lot of world space).
